q.en: In a website address, what does the 'S' in HTTPS stand for?
q.hi: Website address mein HTTPS ke 'S' ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: वेबसाइट पत्त्यातील HTTPS मधील 'S' म्हणजे काय?

en: Speed
Secure
Server
Search
hi: Speed
Secure
Server
Search
mr: Speed
Secure
Server
Search

exp.en: HTTPS = HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure. Data between the browser and the website is encrypted using TLS (still commonly called SSL). It is not about speed or search.
exp.hi: HTTPS = HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure. Browser aur website ke beech ka data TLS (jise log abhi bhi SSL bolte hain) se encrypt hota hai. Iska speed ya search se lena-dena nahi.
exp.mr: HTTPS = HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure. Browser आणि वेबसाइटमधील data TLS (ज्याला अजूनही SSL म्हणतात) ने encrypt होतो. याचा speed किंवा search शी संबंध नाही.

q.en: What is the main job of DNS (Domain Name System)?
q.hi: DNS (Domain Name System) ka main kaam kya hai?
q.mr: DNS (Domain Name System) चे मुख्य काम काय आहे?

en: Storing your website's images and files
Encrypting passwords on your website
Translating domain names into IP addresses
Ranking websites in Google search
hi: Website ki images aur files store karna
Website pe passwords encrypt karna
Domain names ko IP addresses mein translate karna
Google search mein websites ko rank karna
mr: वेबसाइटच्या images आणि files store करणे
वेबसाइटवरील passwords encrypt करणे
Domain names चे IP addresses मध्ये भाषांतर करणे
Google search मध्ये वेबसाइट्सना rank करणे

exp.en: DNS is like the internet's phonebook: it turns a name like mybakery.in into the IP address of the server. Storing files is the hosting's job, not DNS.
exp.hi: DNS internet ki phonebook jaisa hai: mybakery.in jaise naam ko server ke IP address mein badalta hai. Files store karna hosting ka kaam hai, DNS ka nahi.
exp.mr: DNS हे internet चे phonebook आहे: mybakery.in सारखे नाव server च्या IP address मध्ये बदलते. Files store करणे हे hosting चे काम आहे, DNS चे नाही.

q.en: WordPress is best described as a…
q.hi: WordPress ko best kis tarah describe karenge?
q.mr: WordPress चे सर्वात योग्य वर्णन कोणते?

en: Web browser
Domain registrar
Payment gateway
Content Management System (CMS)
hi: Web browser
Domain registrar
Payment gateway
Content Management System (CMS)
mr: Web browser
Domain registrar
Payment gateway
Content Management System (CMS)

exp.en: A CMS lets you create and edit website pages and blog posts without coding. WordPress is the most widely used CMS; you still need a domain and hosting separately (unless you use WordPress.com).
exp.hi: CMS se bina coding ke website pages aur blogs banaye/edit kiye ja sakte hain. WordPress sabse popular CMS hai; domain aur hosting alag se chahiye (WordPress.com use na karo toh).
exp.mr: CMS मुळे coding न करता वेबसाइट pages आणि blogs तयार/edit करता येतात. WordPress हा सर्वात लोकप्रिय CMS आहे; domain आणि hosting वेगळे लागतात (WordPress.com वापरत नसाल तर).

q.en: What does HTML stand for?
q.hi: HTML ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: HTML चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: HyperText Markup Language
High Traffic Marketing Link
Home Tool Markup Language
HyperText Media Loader
hi: HyperText Markup Language
High Traffic Marketing Link
Home Tool Markup Language
HyperText Media Loader
mr: HyperText Markup Language
High Traffic Marketing Link
Home Tool Markup Language
HyperText Media Loader

exp.en: HTML = HyperText Markup Language. It gives a web page its structure: headings, paragraphs, links, images and forms. CSS handles the look; JavaScript adds interactivity.
exp.hi: HTML = HyperText Markup Language. Yeh page ka structure banata hai: headings, paragraphs, links, images, forms. Look CSS se aata hai, interactivity JavaScript se.
exp.mr: HTML = HyperText Markup Language. हे page ची रचना ठरवते: headings, paragraphs, links, images, forms. दिसणे CSS ठरवते आणि interactivity JavaScript देते.

q.en: How is AOV (Average Order Value) calculated?
q.hi: AOV (Average Order Value) kaise calculate karte hain?
q.mr: AOV (Average Order Value) कसा काढतात?

en: Total orders ÷ total visitors
Total revenue ÷ number of orders
Total revenue ÷ number of visitors
Ad spend ÷ number of orders
hi: Total orders ÷ total visitors
Total revenue ÷ number of orders
Total revenue ÷ number of visitors
Ad spend ÷ number of orders
mr: Total orders ÷ total visitors
Total revenue ÷ number of orders
Total revenue ÷ number of visitors
Ad spend ÷ number of orders

exp.en: AOV = revenue ÷ orders. ₹2,00,000 from 400 orders = ₹500 AOV. Orders ÷ visitors is conversion rate; revenue ÷ visitors is revenue per visitor.
exp.hi: AOV = revenue ÷ orders. 400 orders se ₹2,00,000 = ₹500 AOV. Orders ÷ visitors conversion rate hai; revenue ÷ visitors revenue per visitor hai.
exp.mr: AOV = revenue ÷ orders. 400 orders मधून ₹2,00,000 = ₹500 AOV. Orders ÷ visitors म्हणजे conversion rate; revenue ÷ visitors म्हणजे revenue per visitor.

q.en: In Indian digital payments, what does UPI stand for?
q.hi: Indian digital payments mein UPI ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: भारतीय digital payments मध्ये UPI चे पूर्ण रूप काय?

en: Universal Payment Index
United Payment Interchange
Unified Payments Interface
User Pay Integration
hi: Universal Payment Index
United Payment Interchange
Unified Payments Interface
User Pay Integration
mr: Universal Payment Index
United Payment Interchange
Unified Payments Interface
User Pay Integration

exp.en: UPI = Unified Payments Interface, built by NPCI. It lets customers pay instantly from their bank account via apps like PhonePe, Google Pay or Paytm, which is why checkouts in India show UPI prominently.
exp.hi: UPI = Unified Payments Interface, jo NPCI ne banaya. Customer PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm jaise apps se seedha bank account se turant pay karta hai — isliye Indian checkout mein UPI upar dikhaya jata hai.
exp.mr: UPI = Unified Payments Interface, जे NPCI ने बनवले. ग्राहक PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm सारख्या apps मधून थेट bank account मधून लगेच pay करतो — म्हणून भारतीय checkout मध्ये UPI ठळक दिसते.

q.en: In Indian e-commerce, what does COD mean?
q.hi: Indian e-commerce mein COD ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: भारतीय e-commerce मध्ये COD म्हणजे काय?

en: Cost of Delivery
Customer Order Discount
Code of Dispatch
Cash on Delivery
hi: Cost of Delivery
Customer Order Discount
Code of Dispatch
Cash on Delivery
mr: Cost of Delivery
Customer Order Discount
Code of Dispatch
Cash on Delivery

exp.en: COD = Cash on Delivery: the customer pays when the parcel arrives. It builds trust for first-time buyers but raises the risk of refused orders, which come back as costly RTO.
exp.hi: COD = Cash on Delivery: customer parcel aane pe pay karta hai. Naye buyers ka trust badhta hai, lekin refused orders ka risk bhi badhta hai jo mehenga RTO ban ke wapas aata hai.
exp.mr: COD = Cash on Delivery: parcel आल्यावर ग्राहक पैसे देतो. नवीन ग्राहकांचा विश्वास वाढतो, पण order नाकारण्याचा धोका वाढतो, जो महागडा RTO बनून परत येतो.

q.en: What is 2FA (two-factor authentication)?
q.hi: 2FA (two-factor authentication) kya hota hai?
q.mr: 2FA (two-factor authentication) म्हणजे काय?

en: A second check, like an OTP or app code, on top of your password
Using two different passwords for two websites
Logging in from two devices at once
Changing your password twice a year
hi: Password ke upar ek second check, jaise OTP ya app code
Do websites ke liye do alag passwords rakhna
Ek saath do devices se login karna
Saal mein do baar password badalna
mr: Password सोबत दुसरी तपासणी, जसे OTP किंवा app code
दोन websites साठी दोन वेगळे passwords ठेवणे
एकाच वेळी दोन devices वरून login करणे
वर्षातून दोनदा password बदलणे

exp.en: 2FA asks for something extra besides the password (OTP, authenticator app, security key). Even if a phishing page steals your password, the attacker usually can't log in. Turn it on for Ads, Meta Business and your website admin.
exp.hi: 2FA password ke alawa kuch extra maangta hai (OTP, authenticator app, security key). Phishing se password chori ho bhi jaye, attacker aam taur pe login nahi kar pata. Ads, Meta Business aur website admin sab pe on karo.
exp.mr: 2FA password शिवाय आणखी काहीतरी मागते (OTP, authenticator app, security key). Phishing ने password चोरीला गेला तरी attacker सहसा login करू शकत नाही. Ads, Meta Business आणि वेबसाइट admin वर हे चालू ठेवा.

q.en: On a website, what is CSS mainly used for?
q.hi: Website pe CSS mainly kis kaam aata hai?
q.mr: वेबसाइटवर CSS मुख्यतः कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Storing customer data in a database
Styling: colours, fonts, spacing and layout
Sending order emails to customers
Connecting the domain to the server
hi: Database mein customer data store karna
Styling: colours, fonts, spacing aur layout
Customers ko order emails bhejna
Domain ko server se connect karna
mr: Database मध्ये customer data store करणे
Styling: रंग, fonts, spacing आणि layout
ग्राहकांना order emails पाठवणे
Domain ला server शी जोडणे

exp.en: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) controls how HTML looks: colours, fonts, spacing and responsive layouts for mobile. Databases, emails and DNS are handled elsewhere.
exp.hi: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) decide karta hai HTML kaisa dikhega: colours, fonts, spacing, aur mobile ke liye responsive layout. Database, emails, DNS alag cheezein hain.
exp.mr: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) HTML कसे दिसेल ते ठरवते: रंग, fonts, spacing आणि mobile साठी responsive layout. Database, emails, DNS या वेगळ्या गोष्टी आहेत.

q.en: What does 'web hosting' provide?
q.hi: 'Web hosting' kya provide karta hai?
q.mr: 'Web hosting' काय पुरवते?

en: The name people type, like mybrand.in
A logo and brand design for the site
A server that stores your site's files and serves them to visitors
Paid ads that bring traffic to your site
hi: Woh naam jo log type karte hain, jaise mybrand.in
Site ke liye logo aur brand design
Ek server jo site ki files store karke visitors ko dikhata hai
Paid ads jo site pe traffic laate hain
mr: लोक type करतात ते नाव, जसे mybrand.in
साइटसाठी logo आणि brand design
साइटच्या files साठवून visitors ना दाखवणारा server
साइटवर traffic आणणाऱ्या paid ads

exp.en: Hosting is the server space where your website lives. The domain is just the address; DNS points that address to the hosting server. You need both for a live site.
exp.hi: Hosting woh server space hai jahan website rehti hai. Domain sirf address hai; DNS us address ko hosting server tak point karta hai. Live site ke liye dono chahiye.
exp.mr: Hosting म्हणजे server वरील जागा जिथे वेबसाइट राहते. Domain फक्त पत्ता आहे; DNS तो पत्ता hosting server कडे वळवतो. Live साइटसाठी दोन्ही लागतात.

q.en: In e-commerce, what is 'cart abandonment'?
q.hi: E-commerce mein 'cart abandonment' kya hai?
q.mr: E-commerce मध्ये 'cart abandonment' म्हणजे काय?

en: A customer returning a product after delivery
A product going out of stock in the cart
The store deleting old carts every night
A shopper adding items to cart but leaving without buying
hi: Delivery ke baad customer ka product return karna
Cart mein product ka out of stock ho jana
Store ka har raat purane carts delete karna
Shopper ka cart mein items daal ke bina kharide chale jana
mr: Delivery नंतर ग्राहकाने product परत करणे
Cart मधील product out of stock होणे
Store ने दररोज रात्री जुने carts delete करणे
Shopper ने cart मध्ये items टाकून न घेता निघून जाणे

exp.en: Cart abandonment = carts created but not purchased. Common causes are surprise shipping costs, forced sign-up and limited payment options. Reminder emails/WhatsApp and a simpler checkout help recover sales.
exp.hi: Cart abandonment = cart bana par purchase nahi hua. Common reasons: achanak shipping charge, zabardasti sign-up, kam payment options. Reminder email/WhatsApp aur simple checkout se sales wapas aati hai.
exp.mr: Cart abandonment = cart तयार झाला पण खरेदी झाली नाही. सामान्य कारणे: अचानक shipping charge, सक्तीचे sign-up, कमी payment पर्याय. Reminder email/WhatsApp आणि सोपा checkout यामुळे sales परत मिळतात.

q.en: What is 'phishing'?
q.hi: 'Phishing' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Phishing' म्हणजे काय?

en: Fake emails or messages that trick you into giving logins or payment details
A method to find new customers on social media
Buying email lists to send offers
Testing two versions of a landing page
hi: Fake emails ya messages jo dhokhe se login ya payment details nikalwate hain
Social media pe naye customers dhoondhne ka tareeka
Offers bhejne ke liye email lists kharidna
Landing page ke do versions test karna
mr: खोटे emails किंवा messages जे फसवून login किंवा payment details काढून घेतात
Social media वर नवीन ग्राहक शोधण्याची पद्धत
Offers पाठवण्यासाठी email lists विकत घेणे
Landing page च्या दोन versions ची चाचणी

exp.en: Phishing messages pretend to be Google, Meta, a bank or a courier and send you to a lookalike login page. Check the real domain, never enter passwords from a link in a message, and use 2FA.
exp.hi: Phishing messages Google, Meta, bank ya courier ban ke aate hain aur lookalike login page pe bhejte hain. Asli domain check karo, message ke link se kabhi password mat daalo, aur 2FA use karo.
exp.mr: Phishing messages Google, Meta, bank किंवा courier असल्याचे भासवून lookalike login page वर नेतात. खरे domain तपासा, message मधील link वरून कधीही password टाकू नका, आणि 2FA वापरा.

q.en: What is Shopify?
q.hi: Shopify kya hai?
q.mr: Shopify म्हणजे काय?

en: A free web browser for online shopping
A hosted platform to build and run your own online store
A government marketplace for small sellers
A courier company for e-commerce parcels
hi: Online shopping ke liye free web browser
Apna online store banane aur chalane ka hosted platform
Chhote sellers ke liye government marketplace
E-commerce parcels ki courier company
mr: Online shopping साठी मोफत web browser
स्वतःचे online store तयार करून चालवण्याचा hosted platform
छोट्या विक्रेत्यांसाठी सरकारी marketplace
E-commerce parcels साठी courier कंपनी

exp.en: Shopify is a subscription (SaaS) e-commerce platform: hosting, checkout, product catalogue and apps are included. Unlike Amazon or Flipkart, it's your own branded store, so you own the customer relationship.
exp.hi: Shopify ek subscription (SaaS) e-commerce platform hai: hosting, checkout, product catalogue, apps sab included. Amazon/Flipkart se alag, yeh aapka apna branded store hai, customer relationship aapka hota hai.
exp.mr: Shopify हा subscription (SaaS) e-commerce platform आहे: hosting, checkout, product catalogue, apps सर्व समाविष्ट. Amazon/Flipkart पेक्षा वेगळे, हे तुमचे स्वतःचे branded store आहे, ग्राहकाशी नाते तुमचे राहते.

q.en: The domain ending '.in' is India's…
q.hi: Domain ending '.in' India ka kya hai?
q.mr: '.in' हा domain शेवट भारताचा काय आहे?

en: Government-only domain
Internal network domain
Country-code top-level domain (ccTLD)
Domain reserved for startups
hi: Sirf government ka domain
Internal network domain
Country-code top-level domain (ccTLD)
Startups ke liye reserved domain
mr: फक्त सरकारी domain
Internal network domain
Country-code top-level domain (ccTLD)
Startups साठी राखीव domain

exp.en: .in is India's ccTLD and anyone can register it. It signals an Indian audience. Government sites use .gov.in, which is restricted; .com is a generic TLD.
exp.hi: .in India ka ccTLD hai aur koi bhi register kar sakta hai. Yeh Indian audience ka signal deta hai. Government sites .gov.in use karti hain jo restricted hai; .com generic TLD hai.
exp.mr: .in हा भारताचा ccTLD आहे आणि कोणीही register करू शकतो. तो भारतीय audience चा संकेत देतो. सरकारी साइट्स .gov.in वापरतात जे मर्यादित आहे; .com हा generic TLD आहे.

q.en: How is CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) usually calculated?
q.hi: CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) usually kaise calculate hota hai?
q.mr: CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) सहसा कसा काढतात?

en: Revenue ÷ number of customers
Ad spend ÷ number of clicks
Number of customers ÷ marketing spend
Sales & marketing spend ÷ new customers acquired
hi: Revenue ÷ number of customers
Ad spend ÷ number of clicks
Number of customers ÷ marketing spend
Sales & marketing spend ÷ naye customers
mr: Revenue ÷ number of customers
Ad spend ÷ number of clicks
Number of customers ÷ marketing spend
Sales & marketing spend ÷ नवीन ग्राहक

exp.en: CAC = spend to acquire customers ÷ new customers won. ₹1,00,000 spend bringing 200 new buyers = ₹500 CAC. Ad spend ÷ clicks is CPC, a much earlier-funnel metric.
exp.hi: CAC = customers laane ka kharcha ÷ naye customers. ₹1,00,000 spend se 200 naye buyers = ₹500 CAC. Ad spend ÷ clicks CPC hai, jo funnel ka bahut shuru ka metric hai.
exp.mr: CAC = ग्राहक मिळवण्याचा खर्च ÷ नवीन ग्राहक. ₹1,00,000 खर्चातून 200 नवीन buyers = ₹500 CAC. Ad spend ÷ clicks म्हणजे CPC, funnel च्या खूप सुरुवातीचा metric.

q.en: What is a referral program?
q.hi: Referral program kya hota hai?
q.mr: Referral program म्हणजे काय?

en: Rewarding existing customers for bringing in new customers
Paying a celebrity to post about your brand
Showing ads to people who visited your site
Listing your products on a marketplace
hi: Existing customers ko naye customers laane pe reward dena
Celebrity ko brand ke baare mein post karne ke paise dena
Site visit karne walon ko ads dikhana
Marketplace pe products list karna
mr: सध्याच्या ग्राहकांना नवीन ग्राहक आणल्याबद्दल reward देणे
Celebrity ला brand बद्दल post करण्यासाठी पैसे देणे
साइटला भेट दिलेल्यांना ads दाखवणे
Marketplace वर products list करणे

exp.en: Referral programs ('Give ₹100, Get ₹100') turn happy customers into an acquisition channel. Referred customers arrive with trust from a friend. Celebrity posts are influencer marketing; ads to past visitors are retargeting.
exp.hi: Referral programs ('Give ₹100, Get ₹100') khush customers ko acquisition channel bana dete hain. Dost ke trust ke saath naya customer aata hai. Celebrity post influencer marketing hai; past visitors ko ads retargeting hai.
exp.mr: Referral programs ('Give ₹100, Get ₹100') समाधानी ग्राहकांना acquisition channel बनवतात. मित्राच्या विश्वासासह नवीन ग्राहक येतो. Celebrity post म्हणजे influencer marketing; जुन्या visitors ना ads म्हणजे retargeting.

q.en: A site shows the padlock icon (HTTPS). What does that actually guarantee?
q.hi: Site pe padlock icon (HTTPS) dikh raha hai. Iski asli guarantee kya hai?
q.mr: साइटवर padlock icon (HTTPS) दिसतोय. याची खरी हमी काय आहे?

en: The business behind the site is genuine and safe
Data between you and the site is encrypted in transit
The site has been approved by Google
The site cannot be hacked
hi: Site ke peeche ka business genuine aur safe hai
Aapke aur site ke beech data transit mein encrypted hai
Site Google se approved hai
Site hack nahi ho sakti
mr: साइटमागचा व्यवसाय खरा आणि सुरक्षित आहे
तुमच्या आणि साइटमधील data प्रवासात encrypted आहे
साइट Google ने मंजूर केली आहे
साइट hack होऊ शकत नाही

exp.en: The padlock only means the connection is encrypted. Phishing sites can get free certificates too, so a padlock doesn't prove the site is trustworthy — always check the actual domain.
exp.hi: Padlock ka matlab sirf itna hai ki connection encrypted hai. Phishing sites ko bhi free certificate mil jata hai, toh padlock trust ka proof nahi — hamesha asli domain check karo.
exp.mr: Padlock चा अर्थ फक्त connection encrypted आहे इतकाच. Phishing साइट्सनाही मोफत certificate मिळते, म्हणून padlock विश्वासाचा पुरावा नाही — नेहमी खरे domain तपासा.

q.en: What does a CDN (Content Delivery Network) do for a website?
q.hi: CDN (Content Delivery Network) website ke liye kya karta hai?
q.mr: CDN (Content Delivery Network) वेबसाइटसाठी काय करते?

en: Writes SEO content automatically
Registers your domain in many countries
Serves copies of your files from servers close to each visitor
Blocks all bots from visiting your site
hi: Automatically SEO content likhta hai
Aapka domain kai countries mein register karta hai
Visitor ke paas wale servers se aapki files ki copies serve karta hai
Saare bots ko site pe aane se rokta hai
mr: आपोआप SEO content लिहिते
तुमचे domain अनेक देशांत register करते
प्रत्येक visitor जवळच्या servers वरून तुमच्या files च्या copies देते
सर्व bots ना साइटवर येण्यापासून रोखते

exp.en: A CDN (e.g. Cloudflare, Akamai, CloudFront) caches images, CSS and JS on servers worldwide, so a user in Nagpur gets files from a nearby location. Result: faster pages and less load on your main server.
exp.hi: CDN (jaise Cloudflare, Akamai, CloudFront) images, CSS, JS ko duniya bhar ke servers pe cache karta hai, toh Nagpur ka user paas ki location se files leta hai. Result: fast pages aur main server pe kam load.
exp.mr: CDN (उदा. Cloudflare, Akamai, CloudFront) images, CSS, JS जगभरातील servers वर cache करते, त्यामुळे नागपूरच्या user ला जवळच्या ठिकाणाहून files मिळतात. परिणाम: वेगवान pages आणि मुख्य server वर कमी load.

q.en: What does Google's 'mobile-first indexing' mean?
q.hi: Google ki 'mobile-first indexing' ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Google च्या 'mobile-first indexing' चा अर्थ काय?

en: Mobile sites get a paid boost in results
Only apps are indexed, not websites
Desktop pages are removed from Google
Google mainly uses your site's mobile version for indexing and ranking
hi: Mobile sites ko results mein paid boost milta hai
Sirf apps index hote hain, websites nahi
Desktop pages Google se hata diye jaate hain
Google mainly aapki site ka mobile version indexing aur ranking ke liye use karta hai
mr: Mobile साइट्सना results मध्ये paid boost मिळतो
फक्त apps index होतात, websites नाही
Desktop pages Google मधून काढले जातात
Google मुख्यतः तुमच्या साइटचे mobile version indexing आणि ranking साठी वापरते

exp.en: With mobile-first indexing, Googlebot crawls as a smartphone. If your mobile version hides content, reviews or structured data that desktop shows, you can lose rankings — keep content the same on both.
exp.hi: Mobile-first indexing mein Googlebot smartphone ban ke crawl karta hai. Agar mobile version mein woh content, reviews ya structured data chhupa hai jo desktop pe hai, toh ranking gir sakti hai — dono pe same content rakho.
exp.mr: Mobile-first indexing मध्ये Googlebot smartphone म्हणून crawl करतो. Desktop वर असलेले content, reviews किंवा structured data mobile version मध्ये लपलेले असल्यास ranking घसरू शकते — दोन्हीवर सारखे content ठेवा.

q.en: What does 'repeat purchase rate' measure?
q.hi: 'Repeat purchase rate' kya measure karta hai?
q.mr: 'Repeat purchase rate' काय मोजतो?

en: % of customers who bought more than once in a period
% of orders that were returned
% of visitors who added to cart
% of revenue spent on ads
hi: Kisi period mein ek se zyada baar kharidne wale customers ka %
Return hue orders ka %
Add to cart karne wale visitors ka %
Ads pe kharch hue revenue ka %
mr: ठराविक कालावधीत एकापेक्षा जास्त वेळा खरेदी करणाऱ्या ग्राहकांचा %
परत आलेल्या orders चा %
Add to cart करणाऱ्या visitors चा %
Ads वर खर्च झालेल्या revenue चा %

exp.en: Repeat purchase rate = customers with 2+ orders ÷ total customers (for a period). A high rate means the product delivers value and lowers your effective CAC, because repeat orders need little or no ad spend.
exp.hi: Repeat purchase rate = 2+ orders wale customers ÷ total customers (kisi period ke liye). High rate matlab product value de raha hai aur effective CAC kam hota hai, kyunki repeat orders pe ad spend kam lagta hai.
exp.mr: Repeat purchase rate = 2+ orders असलेले ग्राहक ÷ एकूण ग्राहक (ठराविक कालावधीसाठी). जास्त दर म्हणजे product मूल्य देतो आणि effective CAC कमी होतो, कारण repeat orders ला कमी ad spend लागतो.

q.en: A Pune bakery's customers say Chrome shows 'Not secure' next to its website address. What should the owner do?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery ke customers bolte hain ki Chrome website address ke paas 'Not secure' dikhata hai. Owner ko kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका बेकरीचे ग्राहक सांगतात की Chrome वेबसाइट पत्त्याजवळ 'Not secure' दाखवते. मालकाने काय करावे?

en: Ask customers to use a different browser
Install an SSL/TLS certificate and redirect all HTTP pages to HTTPS
Buy a new .com domain
Remove the contact form from the site
hi: Customers ko doosra browser use karne bolo
SSL/TLS certificate install karo aur saare HTTP pages ko HTTPS pe redirect karo
Naya .com domain kharido
Site se contact form hata do
mr: ग्राहकांना दुसरा browser वापरायला सांगा
SSL/TLS certificate install करा आणि सर्व HTTP pages HTTPS वर redirect करा
नवीन .com domain विकत घ्या
साइटवरून contact form काढून टाका

exp.en: Chrome labels plain HTTP pages 'Not secure'. Most hosts offer free certificates (e.g. Let's Encrypt); after installing, 301-redirect HTTP to HTTPS. A new domain wouldn't fix it.
exp.hi: Chrome plain HTTP pages ko 'Not secure' dikhata hai. Zyada tar hosts free certificate dete hain (jaise Let's Encrypt); install karke HTTP ko HTTPS pe 301 redirect karo. Naya domain lene se fix nahi hoga.
exp.mr: Chrome साध्या HTTP pages ना 'Not secure' दाखवते. बहुतेक hosts मोफत certificate देतात (उदा. Let's Encrypt); install करून HTTP ला HTTPS वर 301 redirect करा. नवीन domain घेतल्याने प्रश्न सुटणार नाही.

q.en: What is a browser cookie?
q.hi: Browser cookie kya hoti hai?
q.mr: Browser cookie म्हणजे काय?

en: A virus that slows down your computer
A pop-up offer shown to new visitors
A small piece of data a site stores in your browser, e.g. to keep you logged in
A type of image file used in ads
hi: Ek virus jo computer slow karta hai
Naye visitors ko dikhne wala pop-up offer
Site ka aapke browser mein store kiya chhota data, jaise login yaad rakhne ke liye
Ads mein use hone wali image file
mr: संगणक मंद करणारा virus
नवीन visitors ना दिसणारी pop-up offer
साइटने तुमच्या browser मध्ये साठवलेला छोटा data, उदा. login लक्षात ठेवण्यासाठी
Ads मध्ये वापरली जाणारी image file

exp.en: Cookies are small text values the browser stores and sends back to the site. They power logins, carts and analytics; ad cookies raise privacy concerns, which is why consent banners exist. They are not viruses.
exp.hi: Cookies chhote text values hain jo browser store karke site ko wapas bhejta hai. Login, cart aur analytics inse chalte hain; ad cookies se privacy concern hota hai, isliye consent banners hote hain. Yeh virus nahi hain.
exp.mr: Cookies म्हणजे browser साठवून साइटला परत पाठवतो ते छोटे text values. Login, cart आणि analytics यावर चालतात; ad cookies मुळे privacy चिंता येते, म्हणून consent banners असतात. हे virus नाहीत.

q.en: Which DNS record points a domain directly to a server's IPv4 address?
q.hi: Kaunsa DNS record domain ko seedha server ke IPv4 address pe point karta hai?
q.mr: कोणता DNS record domain ला थेट server च्या IPv4 address कडे वळवतो?

en: MX record
TXT record
NS record
A record
hi: MX record
TXT record
NS record
A record
mr: MX record
TXT record
NS record
A record

exp.en: An A record maps a name to an IPv4 address (AAAA does IPv6). MX records route email, TXT holds verification/SPF text, and NS says which nameservers control the domain.
exp.hi: A record naam ko IPv4 address se map karta hai (IPv6 ke liye AAAA). MX email route karta hai, TXT mein verification/SPF text hota hai, aur NS batata hai kaunse nameservers domain control karte hain.
exp.mr: A record नावाला IPv4 address शी जोडतो (IPv6 साठी AAAA). MX email route करतो, TXT मध्ये verification/SPF मजकूर असतो, आणि NS सांगतो कोणते nameservers domain नियंत्रित करतात.

q.en: How are Amazon 'Sponsored Products' ads mainly charged?
q.hi: Amazon 'Sponsored Products' ads ka charge mainly kaise hota hai?
q.mr: Amazon 'Sponsored Products' ads साठी मुख्यतः कसे पैसे आकारले जातात?

en: Per click (CPC), shown in search results and product pages
A fixed monthly fee per product
A share of every organic sale
Per 1,000 app downloads
hi: Per click (CPC), search results aur product pages pe dikhte hain
Har product ki fixed monthly fee
Har organic sale ka hissa
Har 1,000 app downloads pe
mr: प्रति click (CPC), search results आणि product pages वर दिसतात
प्रत्येक product साठी ठराविक मासिक शुल्क
प्रत्येक organic sale चा वाटा
प्रति 1,000 app downloads

exp.en: Sponsored Products are keyword/product-targeted CPC ads that appear in Amazon search results and on product detail pages. Sellers track ACoS (ad spend ÷ ad-attributed sales) to judge them.
exp.hi: Sponsored Products keyword/product-targeted CPC ads hain jo Amazon search results aur product detail pages pe dikhte hain. Sellers inhe ACoS (ad spend ÷ ad-attributed sales) se judge karte hain.
exp.mr: Sponsored Products हे keyword/product-targeted CPC ads आहेत जे Amazon search results आणि product detail pages वर दिसतात. Sellers ते ACoS (ad spend ÷ ad-attributed sales) ने मोजतात.

q.en: What is a webhook?
q.hi: Webhook kya hota hai?
q.mr: Webhook म्हणजे काय?

en: A hidden link used to boost SEO
An automatic message one app sends to a URL when an event happens, e.g. new order
A browser plug-in that blocks ads
A hook line used at the start of a Reel
hi: SEO boost karne ke liye chhupa link
Event hone pe ek app ka ek URL pe automatic message bhejna, jaise new order
Ads block karne wala browser plug-in
Reel ki shuruaat mein use hone wali hook line
mr: SEO वाढवण्यासाठी लपवलेली link
Event घडल्यावर एका app ने URL वर पाठवलेला automatic message, उदा. new order
Ads block करणारे browser plug-in
Reel च्या सुरुवातीची hook line

exp.en: A webhook pushes data the moment something happens: Shopify or Razorpay can POST 'order paid' to your CRM or WhatsApp tool instantly. With a normal API, your system would have to keep asking (polling).
exp.hi: Webhook event hote hi data push karta hai: Shopify ya Razorpay 'order paid' turant aapke CRM ya WhatsApp tool ko POST kar sakte hain. Normal API mein aapke system ko baar-baar poochna (polling) padta.
exp.mr: Webhook घटना घडताच data push करतो: Shopify किंवा Razorpay 'order paid' लगेच तुमच्या CRM किंवा WhatsApp tool ला POST करू शकतात. साध्या API मध्ये तुमच्या system ला वारंवार विचारावे (polling) लागते.

q.en: In simple terms, what is an API?
q.hi: Simple words mein API kya hai?
q.mr: सोप्या शब्दांत API म्हणजे काय?

en: A design template for landing pages
A type of paid ad on Google
A defined way for one software to request data or actions from another
A tool that checks website grammar
hi: Landing pages ka design template
Google pe ek type ka paid ad
Ek software ka doosre software se data ya action maangne ka fixed tareeka
Website ki grammar check karne wala tool
mr: Landing pages साठी design template
Google वरील एक प्रकारची paid ad
एका software ने दुसऱ्याकडून data किंवा action मागण्याचा ठरलेला मार्ग
वेबसाइटचे व्याकरण तपासणारे tool

exp.en: API = Application Programming Interface. Example: your website asks a courier's API for delivery charges by PIN code, or pulls ad results from the Google Ads API into a dashboard.
exp.hi: API = Application Programming Interface. Example: website courier ke API se PIN code ke hisaab se delivery charge poochti hai, ya dashboard Google Ads API se ad results kheenchta hai.
exp.mr: API = Application Programming Interface. उदा. वेबसाइट courier च्या API कडून PIN code नुसार delivery charge विचारते, किंवा dashboard Google Ads API मधून ad results आणतो.

q.en: In Indian e-commerce logistics, what is RTO?
q.hi: Indian e-commerce logistics mein RTO kya hai?
q.mr: भारतीय e-commerce logistics मध्ये RTO म्हणजे काय?

en: Regional Transport Office approval for delivery vans
Rate of Transaction Online
Return Ticket Order raised by the customer
Return to Origin: undelivered parcel shipped back to the seller
hi: Delivery vans ke liye Regional Transport Office approval
Rate of Transaction Online
Customer ka raise kiya Return Ticket Order
Return to Origin: undelivered parcel seller ko wapas bhejna
mr: Delivery vans साठी Regional Transport Office मंजुरी
Rate of Transaction Online
ग्राहकाने raise केलेला Return Ticket Order
Return to Origin: न पोहोचलेले parcel विक्रेत्याकडे परत पाठवणे

exp.en: RTO = Return to Origin: the parcel couldn't be delivered (refused COD, wrong address, customer unreachable) and returns to the seller. You pay forward and return shipping and earn nothing, so RTO% hits margins hard.
exp.hi: RTO = Return to Origin: parcel deliver nahi hua (COD refuse, galat address, customer unreachable) aur seller ko wapas aaya. Aane-jaane ka shipping aap dete ho aur kamaai zero, isliye RTO% margin ko bahut maarta hai.
exp.mr: RTO = Return to Origin: parcel पोहोचले नाही (COD नाकारले, चुकीचा पत्ता, ग्राहक संपर्कात नाही) आणि विक्रेत्याकडे परत आले. जाण्या-येण्याचे shipping तुम्ही भरता आणि कमाई शून्य, म्हणून RTO% margin ला मोठा फटका देतो.

q.en: A coaching institute sells ₹1,500 study kits online. 35% of COD orders are refused at the door. What's the best first step?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute online ₹1,500 ke study kits bechta hai. 35% COD orders door pe refuse ho jaate hain. Best first step kya hai?
q.mr: एक coaching institute online ₹1,500 चे study kits विकते. 35% COD orders दारात नाकारल्या जातात. सर्वोत्तम पहिले पाऊल कोणते?

en: Confirm COD orders via WhatsApp/call before dispatch and offer a small prepaid discount
Stop selling online and move to walk-in sales only
Switch to a more expensive courier partner
Increase ad spend to get more COD orders
hi: Dispatch se pehle WhatsApp/call se COD orders confirm karo aur prepaid pe chhota discount do
Online bechna band karo, sirf walk-in sales rakho
Zyada mehenga courier partner le lo
Zyada COD orders ke liye ad spend badhao
mr: Dispatch आधी WhatsApp/call ने COD orders confirm करा आणि prepaid वर छोटी सूट द्या
Online विक्री बंद करून फक्त walk-in विक्री ठेवा
जास्त महाग courier partner घ्या
जास्त COD orders साठी ad spend वाढवा

exp.en: Order confirmation filters out impulse and fake orders before you pay shipping, and a prepaid nudge (e.g. ₹50 off on UPI) shifts buyers to payments that can't be refused. More ads would just buy more RTO.
exp.hi: Order confirmation se impulse aur fake orders shipping kharch se pehle hi filter ho jaate hain, aur prepaid nudge (jaise UPI pe ₹50 off) buyers ko aise payment pe le jata hai jo refuse nahi ho sakta. Zyada ads se bas zyada RTO aayega.
exp.mr: Order confirmation मुळे impulse आणि खोट्या orders shipping खर्चाआधीच गाळल्या जातात, आणि prepaid nudge (उदा. UPI वर ₹50 सूट) ग्राहकांना नाकारता न येणाऱ्या payment कडे वळवते. जास्त ads मुळे फक्त जास्त RTO येईल.

q.en: What is 'contribution margin' per order in D2C?
q.hi: D2C mein per order 'contribution margin' kya hota hai?
q.mr: D2C मध्ये प्रति order 'contribution margin' म्हणजे काय?

en: Total revenue including GST
Revenue minus variable costs like product cost, shipping and payment fees
Profit after rent, salaries and all fixed costs
The discount given on each order
hi: GST ke saath total revenue
Revenue minus variable costs jaise product cost, shipping, payment fees
Rent, salaries aur saare fixed costs ke baad profit
Har order pe diya gaya discount
mr: GST सह एकूण revenue
Revenue वजा variable costs जसे product cost, shipping, payment fees
भाडे, पगार आणि सर्व fixed costs नंतरचा नफा
प्रत्येक order वर दिलेली सूट

exp.en: Contribution margin = what each order 'contributes' after costs that scale with orders (COGS, packaging, shipping, gateway fees, returns). Fixed costs like rent come later, in net profit. It decides how much CAC you can afford.
exp.hi: Contribution margin = har order se, order ke saath badhne wale costs (COGS, packaging, shipping, gateway fees, returns) ke baad bacha hissa. Rent jaise fixed costs baad mein net profit mein aate hain. Isi se decide hota hai kitna CAC afford kar sakte ho.
exp.mr: Contribution margin = order सोबत वाढणारे खर्च (COGS, packaging, shipping, gateway fees, returns) वजा करून प्रत्येक order चा उरलेला वाटा. भाड्यासारखे fixed costs नंतर net profit मध्ये येतात. किती CAC परवडेल हे यावरून ठरते.

q.en: Shopify asks you to point 'www' to shops.myshopify.com. Which DNS record type points one hostname to another hostname?
q.hi: Shopify bolta hai 'www' ko shops.myshopify.com pe point karo. Kaunsa DNS record ek hostname ko doosre hostname pe point karta hai?
q.mr: Shopify 'www' ला shops.myshopify.com कडे point करायला सांगते. कोणता DNS record एका hostname ला दुसऱ्या hostname कडे वळवतो?

en: MX record
A record
CNAME record
SPF record
hi: MX record
A record
CNAME record
SPF record
mr: MX record
A record
CNAME record
SPF record

exp.en: A CNAME is an alias: www.mybrand.in → shops.myshopify.com. If the platform later changes its IPs, your site keeps working. An A record needs a fixed IP; MX is for email.
exp.hi: CNAME ek alias hai: www.mybrand.in → shops.myshopify.com. Platform baad mein IP badle toh bhi site chalti rahegi. A record ko fixed IP chahiye; MX email ke liye hai.
exp.mr: CNAME हा alias आहे: www.mybrand.in → shops.myshopify.com. Platform ने नंतर IP बदलला तरी साइट चालू राहते. A record ला ठराविक IP लागतो; MX email साठी आहे.

q.en: A D2C snacks brand has an AOV of ₹620 and offers free shipping on all orders. It wants to raise AOV without hurting conversion much. Best move?
q.hi: Ek D2C snacks brand ka AOV ₹620 hai aur sab orders pe free shipping hai. Conversion zyada hurt kiye bina AOV badhana hai. Best move?
q.mr: एका D2C snacks brand चा AOV ₹620 आहे आणि सर्व orders वर free shipping आहे. Conversion ला फारसा धक्का न देता AOV वाढवायचा आहे. सर्वोत्तम पाऊल?

en: Raise all prices by 30% overnight
Set a minimum order value of ₹2,000
Remove smaller pack sizes from the site
Set free shipping from about ₹799 and suggest relevant add-ons in the cart
hi: Raaton-raat saari prices 30% badha do
₹2,000 ka minimum order value laga do
Site se chhote pack sizes hata do
Lagbhag ₹799 se free shipping rakho aur cart mein relevant add-ons suggest karo
mr: रातोरात सर्व किंमती 30% वाढवा
₹2,000 चा minimum order value ठेवा
साइटवरून छोटे pack sizes काढा
सुमारे ₹799 पासून free shipping ठेवा आणि cart मध्ये संबंधित add-ons सुचवा

exp.en: A free-shipping threshold a little above current AOV nudges shoppers to add one more item, and add-on suggestions make that easy. A ₹2,000 minimum or sudden 30% price hike would kill conversion.
exp.hi: Current AOV se thoda upar free-shipping threshold shoppers ko ek aur item add karne ke liye nudge karta hai, aur add-on suggestions isse aasaan banate hain. ₹2,000 minimum ya achanak 30% price hike conversion khatam kar dega.
exp.mr: सध्याच्या AOV पेक्षा थोडा वर free-shipping threshold ग्राहकांना आणखी एक item घ्यायला प्रवृत्त करतो, आणि add-on सूचना ते सोपे करतात. ₹2,000 minimum किंवा अचानक 30% दरवाढ conversion संपवेल.

q.en: What's a key difference between cookies and localStorage in a browser?
q.hi: Browser mein cookies aur localStorage mein key difference kya hai?
q.mr: Browser मधील cookies आणि localStorage मध्ये मुख्य फरक काय?

en: Cookies are sent to the server with requests; localStorage stays in the browser
localStorage is sent with every request; cookies never leave the browser
Cookies can store more data than localStorage
localStorage is deleted every time the tab closes
hi: Cookies requests ke saath server ko jaati hain; localStorage browser mein hi rehta hai
localStorage har request ke saath jaata hai; cookies browser se bahar nahi jaati
Cookies localStorage se zyada data store kar sakti hain
Tab band hote hi localStorage delete ho jaata hai
mr: Cookies requests सोबत server ला जातात; localStorage browser मध्येच राहते
localStorage प्रत्येक request सोबत जाते; cookies browser बाहेर जात नाहीत
Cookies मध्ये localStorage पेक्षा जास्त data साठवता येतो
Tab बंद होताच localStorage delete होते

exp.en: Cookies (a few KB each) travel with HTTP requests, so servers use them for logins and sessions. localStorage holds more data (typically a few MB), is read only by page scripts, and persists until cleared. sessionStorage is the one that clears when the tab closes.
exp.hi: Cookies (kuch KB) HTTP requests ke saath jaati hain, isliye server login/session ke liye use karta hai. localStorage zyada data (aam taur pe kuch MB) rakhta hai, sirf page scripts padhti hain, aur clear karne tak rehta hai. Tab band hone pe sessionStorage clear hota hai.
exp.mr: Cookies (काही KB) HTTP requests सोबत जातात, म्हणून server login/session साठी वापरतो. localStorage जास्त data (सहसा काही MB) ठेवते, फक्त page scripts वाचतात, आणि clear करेपर्यंत राहते. Tab बंद झाल्यावर sessionStorage clear होते.

q.en: What is ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)?
q.hi: ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce) kya hai?
q.mr: ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce) म्हणजे काय?

en: A government-owned shopping app like Amazon
A government-backed open network letting buyer apps and seller apps work together
A new UPI app for merchants
A tax filing portal for online sellers
hi: Amazon jaisa government-owned shopping app
Government-backed open network jisme buyer apps aur seller apps ek saath kaam karte hain
Merchants ke liye naya UPI app
Online sellers ke liye tax filing portal
mr: Amazon सारखे सरकारी shopping app
सरकार-समर्थित open network ज्यात buyer apps आणि seller apps एकत्र काम करतात
Merchants साठी नवीन UPI app
Online sellers साठी tax filing portal

exp.en: ONDC, an initiative backed by DPIIT, is a network protocol, not a single app. A seller listed via one seller app can be discovered by shoppers on different buyer apps, similar to how UPI connects different payment apps.
exp.hi: ONDC, DPIIT-backed initiative, ek network protocol hai, single app nahi. Ek seller app pe listed seller alag-alag buyer apps pe shoppers ko dikh sakta hai — jaise UPI alag payment apps ko jodta hai.
exp.mr: ONDC, DPIIT-समर्थित उपक्रम, हा network protocol आहे, एकच app नाही. एका seller app वर listed विक्रेता वेगवेगळ्या buyer apps वरील ग्राहकांना दिसू शकतो — जसे UPI वेगवेगळ्या payment apps ना जोडते.

q.en: In D2C unit economics, what is 'CAC payback period'?
q.hi: D2C unit economics mein 'CAC payback period' kya hai?
q.mr: D2C unit economics मध्ये 'CAC payback period' म्हणजे काय?

en: Days taken for the payment gateway to settle money
Time until the ad platform refunds unused budget
Time for a customer's contribution margin to cover the cost of acquiring them
Months until the product's warranty expires
hi: Payment gateway ko paisa settle karne mein lagne wale din
Ad platform ka unused budget refund karne tak ka time
Customer ke contribution margin se unka acquisition cost cover hone ka time
Product ki warranty khatam hone tak ke mahine
mr: Payment gateway ला पैसे settle करायला लागणारे दिवस
Ad platform न वापरलेले budget परत करेपर्यंतचा वेळ
ग्राहकाच्या contribution margin ने त्याचा acquisition cost भरून निघण्याचा वेळ
Product ची warranty संपेपर्यंतचे महिने

exp.en: Payback = how long until cumulative contribution from a customer's orders equals CAC. Short payback means you can recycle cash into growth quickly; long payback needs more funding even if LTV looks great.
exp.hi: Payback = customer ke orders ka cumulative contribution CAC ke barabar hone mein kitna time lagta hai. Short payback matlab cash jaldi growth mein wapas laga sakte ho; long payback mein LTV achha ho tab bhi zyada funding chahiye.
exp.mr: Payback = ग्राहकाच्या orders मधील एकूण contribution CAC इतके होण्यास लागणारा वेळ. कमी payback म्हणजे cash लवकर पुन्हा growth मध्ये लावता येतो; जास्त payback ला LTV चांगला असूनही जास्त funding लागते.

q.en: A Shopify jewellery store's product pages take 8+ seconds to load on 4G. Each product photo is a 3–4 MB PNG. What's the best first fix?
q.hi: Ek Shopify jewellery store ke product pages 4G pe 8+ second mein load hote hain. Har product photo 3–4 MB ka PNG hai. Best first fix?
q.mr: एका Shopify jewellery store चे product pages 4G वर 8+ सेकंदात load होतात. प्रत्येक product photo 3–4 MB चा PNG आहे. सर्वोत्तम पहिला उपाय?

en: Move to a more expensive Shopify plan
Add more product photos per page to look premium
Turn off HTTPS to save loading time
Resize and compress images, use WebP/AVIF, and lazy-load below-the-fold images
hi: Zyada mehenga Shopify plan le lo
Premium dikhne ke liye har page pe aur photos daalo
Loading time bachane ke liye HTTPS band karo
Images resize aur compress karo, WebP/AVIF use karo, aur neeche wali images lazy-load karo
mr: जास्त महाग Shopify plan घ्या
Premium दिसण्यासाठी प्रत्येक page वर आणखी photos टाका
Loading वेळ वाचवण्यासाठी HTTPS बंद करा
Images resize आणि compress करा, WebP/AVIF वापरा, आणि खालच्या images lazy-load करा

exp.en: Oversized images are the most common cause of slow product pages. Properly sized, compressed WebP/AVIF files are often 80–90% smaller with no visible loss. Keep the main (LCP) image eager-loaded; lazy-load the rest.
exp.hi: Bade images slow product pages ki sabse common wajah hain. Sahi size ki compressed WebP/AVIF files aksar 80–90% chhoti hoti hain bina visible loss ke. Main (LCP) image turant load karo; baaki lazy-load.
exp.mr: मोठ्या images हे मंद product pages चे सर्वात सामान्य कारण आहे. योग्य आकाराच्या compressed WebP/AVIF files अनेकदा दिसणारा फरक न होता 80–90% लहान असतात. मुख्य (LCP) image लगेच load करा; बाकीच्या lazy-load करा.

q.en: A café prices coffee: Small ₹180, Medium ₹290, Large ₹310. Most people now pick Large. Which pricing tactic is this?
q.hi: Ek café coffee ki pricing: Small ₹180, Medium ₹290, Large ₹310. Ab zyada log Large lete hain. Yeh kaunsi pricing tactic hai?
q.mr: एका café ची coffee pricing: Small ₹180, Medium ₹290, Large ₹310. आता बहुतेक लोक Large घेतात. ही कोणती pricing tactic आहे?

en: Decoy effect
Charm pricing
Penetration pricing
Dynamic pricing
hi: Decoy effect
Charm pricing
Penetration pricing
Dynamic pricing
mr: Decoy effect
Charm pricing
Penetration pricing
Dynamic pricing

exp.en: Medium is the decoy: it's priced so close to Large that Large looks like the obvious value. Charm pricing is ending prices in 9 (₹299); penetration pricing is launching low to win share.
exp.hi: Medium decoy hai: iski price Large ke itne paas hai ki Large obvious value lagta hai. Charm pricing matlab price 9 pe khatam karna (₹299); penetration pricing matlab share jeetne ke liye low price pe launch.
exp.mr: Medium हा decoy आहे: त्याची किंमत Large च्या इतकी जवळ आहे की Large स्पष्टपणे फायद्याचा वाटतो. Charm pricing म्हणजे किंमत 9 ने संपवणे (₹299); penetration pricing म्हणजे बाजार हिस्सा मिळवण्यासाठी कमी किंमतीत launch.

q.en: What makes a good 'North Star metric'?
q.hi: Achha 'North Star metric' kaisa hota hai?
q.mr: चांगला 'North Star metric' कसा असतो?

en: The metric that looks biggest in investor decks
A single metric that captures the core value customers get and predicts long-term growth
Total page views across all channels
The number of social media followers
hi: Investor decks mein sabse bada dikhne wala metric
Ek metric jo customers ko milne wali core value capture kare aur long-term growth predict kare
Saare channels ke total page views
Social media followers ki ginti
mr: Investor decks मध्ये सर्वात मोठा दिसणारा metric
ग्राहकांना मिळणारे मुख्य मूल्य पकडणारा आणि दीर्घकालीन growth सूचित करणारा एक metric
सर्व channels वरील एकूण page views
Social media followers ची संख्या

exp.en: A North Star reflects delivered value, e.g. 'weekly orders delivered' for a grocery app or 'active paying clinics' for clinic software. Page views and followers are vanity metrics that can grow while the business doesn't.
exp.hi: North Star delivered value dikhata hai, jaise grocery app ke liye 'weekly orders delivered' ya clinic software ke liye 'active paying clinics'. Page views aur followers vanity metrics hain jo business na badhe tab bhi badh sakte hain.
exp.mr: North Star दिलेले मूल्य दाखवतो, उदा. grocery app साठी 'weekly orders delivered' किंवा clinic software साठी 'active paying clinics'. Page views आणि followers हे vanity metrics आहेत जे व्यवसाय न वाढताही वाढू शकतात.

q.en: A clinic's marketer gets an email: 'Your Google Ads account is suspended — verify now', linking to g00gle-ads-support.com. What should she do?
q.hi: Ek clinic ke marketer ko email aata hai: 'Your Google Ads account is suspended — verify now', link g00gle-ads-support.com ka hai. Use kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: एका clinic च्या marketer ला email येतो: 'Your Google Ads account is suspended — verify now', link g00gle-ads-support.com ची आहे. तिने काय करावे?

en: Click quickly and log in so ads don't stop
Forward it to the whole team so everyone can verify
Don't click; open ads.google.com directly to check, and report the email as phishing
Reply to the email asking for proof
hi: Jaldi click karke login karo taaki ads na rukein
Poori team ko forward karo taaki sab verify karein
Click mat karo; seedha ads.google.com khol ke check karo aur email ko phishing report karo
Email ka reply karke proof maango
mr: Ads थांबू नयेत म्हणून पटकन click करून login करा
सगळ्यांनी verify करावे म्हणून पूर्ण team ला forward करा
Click करू नका; थेट ads.google.com उघडून तपासा आणि email phishing म्हणून report करा
Email ला reply करून पुरावा मागा

exp.en: The lookalike domain (zeros instead of o's) and urgency are classic phishing signs. Always check account status by typing the real site yourself. Replying or forwarding only spreads the risk.
exp.hi: Lookalike domain (o ki jagah zero) aur urgency classic phishing signs hain. Account status hamesha khud asli site type karke check karo. Reply ya forward karne se risk bas failta hai.
exp.mr: Lookalike domain (o ऐवजी शून्य) आणि घाई ही phishing ची ठळक लक्षणे आहेत. Account status नेहमी स्वतः खरी साइट type करून तपासा. Reply किंवा forward केल्याने धोका फक्त पसरतो.

q.en: You changed a DNS record, but some users still reach the old server for hours. Why?
q.hi: Aapne DNS record badla, par kuch users ghanton tak purane server pe hi ja rahe hain. Kyun?
q.mr: तुम्ही DNS record बदलला, पण काही users तासन्तास जुन्याच server वर जात आहेत. का?

en: The domain registrar is blocking the change
Browsers need the website to be re-indexed by Google first
The SSL certificate forces users to the old server
DNS resolvers cache the old record until its TTL expires
hi: Domain registrar change block kar raha hai
Browsers ko pehle Google se re-index chahiye
SSL certificate users ko purane server pe bhejta hai
DNS resolvers purana record TTL khatam hone tak cache rakhte hain
mr: Domain registrar बदल अडवत आहे
Browsers ला आधी Google कडून re-index लागते
SSL certificate users ना जुन्या server वर पाठवते
DNS resolvers जुना record TTL संपेपर्यंत cache ठेवतात

exp.en: Each DNS record has a TTL (time to live). ISPs and devices keep the cached answer until it expires, so changes 'propagate' gradually. Google indexing has nothing to do with where DNS points.
exp.hi: Har DNS record ka TTL (time to live) hota hai. ISPs aur devices cached answer expire hone tak rakhte hain, isliye change dheere-dheere 'propagate' hota hai. Google indexing ka DNS se koi lena-dena nahi.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक DNS record ला TTL (time to live) असतो. ISPs आणि devices cache केलेले उत्तर expire होईपर्यंत ठेवतात, म्हणून बदल हळूहळू 'propagate' होतो. Google indexing चा DNS शी संबंध नाही.

q.en: How is a 'growth loop' different from a traditional funnel?
q.hi: 'Growth loop' traditional funnel se kaise alag hai?
q.mr: 'Growth loop' पारंपरिक funnel पेक्षा कसा वेगळा आहे?

en: The output of one cycle, like new users or content, feeds the next cycle
It only works with paid ads
It removes the need for a product
It measures only the top of the funnel
hi: Ek cycle ka output, jaise naye users ya content, agle cycle ko feed karta hai
Yeh sirf paid ads ke saath chalta hai
Isme product ki zaroorat hi nahi
Yeh sirf funnel ka top measure karta hai
mr: एका cycle चे output, जसे नवीन users किंवा content, पुढच्या cycle ला खाद्य देते
हे फक्त paid ads सोबत चालते
यात product ची गरजच नाही
हे फक्त funnel चा वरचा भाग मोजते

exp.en: A funnel ends at conversion; a loop reinvests its output. Example: users post reviews → reviews rank in Google → new visitors sign up → they post more reviews. Loops compound; funnels need constant fresh input.
exp.hi: Funnel conversion pe khatam hota hai; loop apna output wapas lagata hai. Example: users reviews post karte hain → reviews Google mein rank → naye visitors sign up → woh aur reviews post karte hain. Loops compound hote hain; funnels ko hamesha naya input chahiye.
exp.mr: Funnel conversion ला संपतो; loop त्याचे output पुन्हा वापरतो. उदा. users reviews टाकतात → reviews Google मध्ये rank होतात → नवीन visitors sign up करतात → ते आणखी reviews टाकतात. Loops चक्रवाढ होतात; funnels ना सतत नवीन input लागतो.

q.en: A D2C haircare brand: AOV ₹1,000, contribution before ads ₹400 per order, CAC ₹600. The first order loses ₹200. When does this model work?
q.hi: Ek D2C haircare brand: AOV ₹1,000, ads se pehle contribution ₹400 per order, CAC ₹600. Pehla order ₹200 ka loss deta hai. Yeh model kab chalega?
q.mr: एक D2C haircare brand: AOV ₹1,000, ads आधी contribution ₹400 प्रति order, CAC ₹600. पहिल्या order ला ₹200 तोटा होतो. हे model कधी चालेल?

en: Only if AOV is raised above ₹5,000
If enough customers reorder so cumulative contribution beats CAC within a payback you can fund
Never — any first-order loss means the business is broken
If the brand stops tracking CAC
hi: Sirf tab jab AOV ₹5,000 se upar ho
Agar kaafi customers reorder karein taaki cumulative contribution affordable payback mein CAC se aage nikle
Kabhi nahi — first-order loss matlab business toota hua hai
Agar brand CAC track karna band kar de
mr: फक्त AOV ₹5,000 च्या वर गेला तर
पुरेसे ग्राहक पुन्हा order करून एकूण contribution परवडणाऱ्या payback मध्ये CAC पेक्षा जास्त झाले तर
कधीच नाही — first-order तोटा म्हणजे व्यवसाय बिघडलेला
Brand ने CAC track करणे बंद केले तर

exp.en: Many consumable D2C brands lose money on order one and profit on repeats. Here one more order (₹400) turns the customer profitable — but only if repeat rates are real and you have cash to wait. Ignoring CAC hides the problem.
exp.hi: Kai consumable D2C brands pehle order pe loss aur repeats pe profit karte hain. Yahan ek aur order (₹400) customer ko profitable bana deta hai — par sirf tab jab repeat rate asli ho aur wait karne ka cash ho. CAC ignore karna problem chhupata hai.
exp.mr: अनेक consumable D2C brands पहिल्या order वर तोटा आणि repeats वर नफा कमावतात. इथे आणखी एक order (₹400) ग्राहकाला फायदेशीर बनवते — पण फक्त repeat दर खरा असेल आणि थांबण्याइतका cash असेल तर. CAC दुर्लक्षित केल्याने समस्या लपते.

q.en: Which is the best example of product-led growth (PLG)?
q.hi: Product-led growth (PLG) ka best example kaunsa hai?
q.mr: Product-led growth (PLG) चे सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण कोणते?

en: A sales team cold-calling 500 leads a day
A TV campaign during a cricket match
A free plan where users share designs that carry the tool's link, pulling in new users
Hiring more sales reps to close enterprise deals
hi: Sales team roz 500 leads ko cold-call kare
Cricket match ke dauraan TV campaign
Free plan jisme users designs share karte hain jin pe tool ka link hota hai, aur naye users aate hain
Enterprise deals ke liye zyada sales reps hire karna
mr: Sales team दररोज 500 leads ना cold-call करते
Cricket सामन्यादरम्यान TV campaign
Free plan ज्यात users tool ची link असलेले designs share करतात आणि नवीन users येतात
Enterprise deals साठी जास्त sales reps नेमणे

exp.en: In PLG the product itself drives acquisition, activation and upgrades — free plans, trials and in-product sharing (think Canva, Zoom invites). Cold calling and TV are sales-led or marketing-led motions.
exp.hi: PLG mein product khud acquisition, activation aur upgrades chalata hai — free plans, trials, in-product sharing (Canva, Zoom invites jaisa). Cold calling aur TV sales-led ya marketing-led motions hain.
exp.mr: PLG मध्ये product स्वतः acquisition, activation आणि upgrades चालवतो — free plans, trials, in-product sharing (Canva, Zoom invites सारखे). Cold calling आणि TV हे sales-led किंवा marketing-led मार्ग आहेत.

q.en: A Pune clothing brand is moving from oldbrand.in to newbrand.in. Its blog and product pages get good Google traffic. Best way to keep rankings?
q.hi: Ek Pune clothing brand oldbrand.in se newbrand.in pe shift ho raha hai. Iske blog aur product pages pe achha Google traffic hai. Rankings bachane ka best tareeka?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एक clothing brand oldbrand.in वरून newbrand.in वर जात आहे. त्याच्या blog आणि product pages ना चांगला Google traffic आहे. Rankings टिकवण्याचा सर्वोत्तम मार्ग?

en: Redirect every old URL to the new homepage
Let the old domain expire and start fresh
Copy all content to the new domain and keep both live
301-redirect each old URL to its matching new URL and use Search Console's Change of Address tool
hi: Har purana URL naye homepage pe redirect karo
Purana domain expire hone do aur fresh start karo
Saara content naye domain pe copy karo aur dono live rakho
Har purane URL ko matching naye URL pe 301-redirect karo aur Search Console ka Change of Address tool use karo
mr: प्रत्येक जुनी URL नवीन homepage वर redirect करा
जुने domain expire होऊ द्या आणि नव्याने सुरुवात करा
सर्व content नवीन domain वर copy करून दोन्ही live ठेवा
प्रत्येक जुनी URL तिच्या जुळणाऱ्या नवीन URL वर 301-redirect करा आणि Search Console चे Change of Address tool वापरा

exp.en: Page-to-page 301s pass signals to the right new pages, and Change of Address tells Google about the move. Redirecting everything to the homepage is treated like soft 404s; keeping both live creates duplicate content.
exp.hi: Page-to-page 301 signals sahi naye pages tak pahunchate hain, aur Change of Address Google ko move ke baare mein batata hai. Sab kuch homepage pe redirect karna soft 404 jaisa maana jata hai; dono live rakhne se duplicate content banta hai.
exp.mr: Page-to-page 301 signals योग्य नवीन pages पर्यंत पोहोचवतात, आणि Change of Address Google ला बदलाची माहिती देते. सर्व काही homepage वर redirect करणे soft 404 सारखे मानले जाते; दोन्ही live ठेवल्याने duplicate content तयार होतो.

q.en: A Shopify store sees most carts abandoned right after the ₹99 shipping fee appears at the last checkout step. Best fix?
q.hi: Ek Shopify store mein zyada tar carts tab abandon hote hain jab last checkout step pe ₹99 shipping fee dikhti hai. Best fix?
q.mr: एका Shopify store मध्ये शेवटच्या checkout step वर ₹99 shipping fee दिसताच बहुतेक carts सोडले जातात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Show shipping cost (or free-shipping threshold) early, on product and cart pages
Hide the fee until after payment
Add more steps to checkout to build trust
Send more retargeting ads without changing checkout
hi: Shipping cost (ya free-shipping threshold) pehle hi product aur cart pages pe dikhao
Fee ko payment ke baad tak chhupao
Trust badhane ke liye checkout mein aur steps jodo
Checkout badle bina aur retargeting ads chalao
mr: Shipping खर्च (किंवा free-shipping threshold) आधीच product आणि cart pages वर दाखवा
Payment नंतरपर्यंत fee लपवा
विश्वास वाढवण्यासाठी checkout मध्ये आणखी steps जोडा
Checkout न बदलता आणखी retargeting ads चालवा

exp.en: Unexpected extra costs at the end are one of the most-cited reasons for abandonment. Being upfront (or building shipping into price/threshold) removes the shock. Hiding fees is deceptive; retargeting doesn't fix the leak.
exp.hi: End mein achanak extra cost abandonment ki sabse zyada batayi jaane wali wajahon mein se ek hai. Pehle se batana (ya shipping ko price/threshold mein jodna) shock hata deta hai. Fee chhupana dhokha hai; retargeting leak fix nahi karta.
exp.mr: शेवटी अचानक येणारा अतिरिक्त खर्च हे cart सोडण्याचे सर्वाधिक नमूद कारण आहे. आधीच सांगणे (किंवा shipping किंमत/threshold मध्ये धरणे) धक्का टाळते. Fee लपवणे फसवणूक आहे; retargeting गळती थांबवत नाही.

q.en: Your server receives 'payment successful' webhooks from a payment gateway. What's the key security step before trusting them?
q.hi: Aapke server ko payment gateway se 'payment successful' webhooks aate hain. Trust karne se pehle key security step kya hai?
q.mr: तुमच्या server ला payment gateway कडून 'payment successful' webhooks येतात. त्यांवर विश्वास ठेवण्याआधी मुख्य security पाऊल कोणते?

en: Check that the request came from an Indian IP
Verify the webhook's signature using your shared secret
Accept only webhooks received during business hours
Ask the customer to confirm by email
hi: Check karo ki request Indian IP se aayi
Apne shared secret se webhook ka signature verify karo
Sirf business hours mein aaye webhooks accept karo
Customer se email pe confirm karwao
mr: Request भारतीय IP वरून आली का ते तपासा
तुमच्या shared secret ने webhook ची signature verify करा
फक्त कामाच्या वेळेत आलेले webhooks स्वीकारा
ग्राहकाला email वर confirm करायला सांगा

exp.en: Gateways and platforms like Razorpay and Shopify sign webhooks (HMAC) with a secret only you and they know. Verifying it stops anyone from faking a 'paid' call to your endpoint. IP location proves nothing.
exp.hi: Razorpay aur Shopify jaise platforms webhooks ko secret se sign (HMAC) karte hain jo sirf aap aur woh jaante ho. Verify karne se koi bhi fake 'paid' call nahi bhej sakta. IP location se kuch prove nahi hota.
exp.mr: Razorpay आणि Shopify सारखे platforms webhooks फक्त तुम्हाला आणि त्यांना माहीत असलेल्या secret ने sign (HMAC) करतात. Verify केल्याने कोणीही खोटा 'paid' call पाठवू शकत नाही. IP location काहीही सिद्ध करत नाही.

q.en: Showing 'MRP ₹1,999' struck through next to 'Now ₹999' mainly uses which psychological effect?
q.hi: 'Now ₹999' ke paas kata hua 'MRP ₹1,999' dikhana mainly kaunsa psychological effect use karta hai?
q.mr: 'Now ₹999' शेजारी खोडलेली 'MRP ₹1,999' दाखवणे मुख्यतः कोणता मानसशास्त्रीय परिणाम वापरते?

en: Social proof
Scarcity
Anchoring
Reciprocity
hi: Social proof
Scarcity
Anchoring
Reciprocity
mr: Social proof
Scarcity
Anchoring
Reciprocity

exp.en: The first number seen (₹1,999) becomes the anchor, so ₹999 feels like a big saving. Scarcity is 'only 3 left'; social proof is '10,000 happy customers'. The reference price must be genuine to stay honest and legal.
exp.hi: Pehla dikha number (₹1,999) anchor ban jata hai, toh ₹999 badi saving lagti hai. Scarcity matlab 'sirf 3 bache'; social proof matlab '10,000 happy customers'. Reference price genuine honi chahiye, warna yeh misleading hai.
exp.mr: पहिला दिसलेला आकडा (₹1,999) anchor बनतो, त्यामुळे ₹999 मोठी बचत वाटते. Scarcity म्हणजे 'फक्त 3 शिल्लक'; social proof म्हणजे '10,000 समाधानी ग्राहक'. Reference किंमत खरी असावी, नाहीतर ती दिशाभूल करणारी ठरते.

q.en: You're browsing mybrand.in. Which cookie is a 'first-party' cookie?
q.hi: Aap mybrand.in browse kar rahe ho. Kaunsi cookie 'first-party' cookie hai?
q.mr: तुम्ही mybrand.in browse करत आहात. कोणती cookie 'first-party' cookie आहे?

en: A cookie set by an ad network's domain loaded on the page
Any cookie that stores an email address
Any cookie that expires within one day
A cookie set by mybrand.in itself
hi: Page pe load hue ad network ke domain ki cookie
Koi bhi cookie jo email address store kare
Koi bhi cookie jo ek din mein expire ho
mybrand.in ki khud ki set ki hui cookie
mr: Page वर load झालेल्या ad network च्या domain ने set केलेली cookie
Email address साठवणारी कोणतीही cookie
एका दिवसात expire होणारी कोणतीही cookie
mybrand.in ने स्वतः set केलेली cookie

exp.en: First-party = set by the domain in the address bar; third-party = set by another domain (e.g. an ad network) embedded in the page. Browsers restrict third-party cookies far more, which is why first-party data matters.
exp.hi: First-party = address bar wale domain ki cookie; third-party = page mein embedded doosre domain (jaise ad network) ki. Browsers third-party cookies ko kaafi zyada restrict karte hain, isliye first-party data important hai.
exp.mr: First-party = address bar मधील domain ने set केलेली; third-party = page मध्ये embedded दुसऱ्या domain (उदा. ad network) ने set केलेली. Browsers third-party cookies वर खूप जास्त बंधने घालतात, म्हणून first-party data महत्त्वाचा आहे.

q.en: An Amazon seller's Sponsored Products show ACoS of 40%. The product's margin before ad costs is 30% of the selling price. What does this mean?
q.hi: Ek Amazon seller ke Sponsored Products ka ACoS 40% hai. Ad cost se pehle product ka margin selling price ka 30% hai. Iska matlab?
q.mr: एका Amazon seller च्या Sponsored Products चा ACoS 40% आहे. Ad खर्चाआधी product चे margin विक्री किंमतीच्या 30% आहे. याचा अर्थ?

en: Ad-attributed sales lose about 10% of sale value, unless ads lift organic rank or repeats enough
The ads are highly profitable because ACoS is below 50%
ACoS doesn't matter on Amazon, only clicks do
The seller should raise bids to lower ACoS
hi: Ad-attributed sales pe sale value ka lagbhag 10% loss hai, jab tak ads organic rank ya repeats na badhayein
ACoS 50% se kam hai toh ads bahut profitable hain
Amazon pe ACoS matter nahi karta, sirf clicks
ACoS kam karne ke liye bids badhao
mr: Ad-attributed sales वर विक्री मूल्याच्या सुमारे 10% तोटा आहे, जोपर्यंत ads organic rank किंवा repeats पुरेसे वाढवत नाहीत
ACoS 50% पेक्षा कमी आहे म्हणून ads खूप फायदेशीर आहेत
Amazon वर ACoS महत्त्वाचा नाही, फक्त clicks
ACoS कमी करण्यासाठी bids वाढवा

exp.en: Break-even ACoS ≈ your pre-ad margin (30%). At 40%, each ad sale costs more in ads than it earns. It can still be a deliberate launch investment if sales velocity lifts organic ranking; watch TACoS (ad spend ÷ total sales). Higher bids usually raise ACoS.
exp.hi: Break-even ACoS ≈ ad se pehle ka margin (30%). 40% pe har ad sale kamaai se zyada ad cost leti hai. Launch investment ho sakta hai agar sales velocity organic ranking badhaye; TACoS (ad spend ÷ total sales) dekho. Bids badhane se aksar ACoS badhta hai.
exp.mr: Break-even ACoS ≈ ad आधीचे margin (30%). 40% वर प्रत्येक ad sale कमाईपेक्षा जास्त ad खर्च घेते. Sales velocity ने organic ranking वाढत असेल तर ही launch गुंतवणूक असू शकते; TACoS (ad spend ÷ total sales) पहा. Bids वाढवल्याने सहसा ACoS वाढतो.

q.en: A skincare brand's 'Refer & get ₹300' program is being abused: people refer their own second numbers and cancel orders after collecting rewards. Best fix?
q.hi: Ek skincare brand ke 'Refer & get ₹300' program ka misuse ho raha hai: log apne hi doosre number refer karke reward lene ke baad order cancel kar dete hain. Best fix?
q.mr: एका skincare brand च्या 'Refer & get ₹300' program चा गैरवापर होतोय: लोक स्वतःचेच दुसरे नंबर refer करतात आणि reward घेऊन order रद्द करतात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Shut down referrals completely
Release rewards only after the referee's order is delivered and past the return window, with duplicate checks
Double the reward so honest users stay motivated
Allow referrals only on Instagram
hi: Referrals poori tarah band karo
Reward tabhi do jab referee ka order deliver ho aur return window nikal jaye, saath mein duplicate checks
Honest users ke liye reward double karo
Referrals sirf Instagram pe allow karo
mr: Referrals पूर्णपणे बंद करा
Referee ची order deliver होऊन return window संपल्यावरच reward द्या, सोबत duplicate checks
प्रामाणिक users साठी reward दुप्पट करा
Referrals फक्त Instagram वर परवानगी द्या

exp.en: Tie rewards to a real, completed purchase and add checks for the same device, address, phone or payment method. That keeps the channel alive for genuine referrers; doubling rewards only increases the fraud incentive.
exp.hi: Reward ko asli, complete purchase se jodo aur same device, address, phone ya payment method ke checks lagao. Isse genuine referrers ke liye channel zinda rehta hai; reward double karne se fraud ka incentive badhta hai.
exp.mr: Reward खऱ्या, पूर्ण झालेल्या खरेदीशी जोडा आणि एकच device, पत्ता, phone किंवा payment method यांची तपासणी करा. यामुळे खऱ्या referrers साठी channel चालू राहतो; reward दुप्पट केल्याने फसवणुकीचा मोह वाढतो.

q.en: Why do growth teams analyse repeat purchases by monthly cohorts instead of one overall repeat rate?
q.hi: Growth teams repeat purchases ko ek overall repeat rate ki jagah monthly cohorts mein kyun analyse karti hain?
q.mr: Growth teams repeat purchases एकूण repeat rate ऐवजी monthly cohorts मध्ये का तपासतात?

en: Cohorts always show higher numbers for investors
Ad platforms only report data in cohorts
The overall rate mixes old and new customers, hiding whether recent customers are retaining better or worse
Cohorts remove the need to track CAC
hi: Cohorts investors ko hamesha bade numbers dikhate hain
Ad platforms sirf cohorts mein data dete hain
Overall rate purane-naye customers mila deta hai, aur chhupata hai ki recent customers behtar retain ho rahe ya nahi
Cohorts se CAC track karne ki zaroorat khatam
mr: Cohorts गुंतवणूकदारांना नेहमी मोठे आकडे दाखवतात
Ad platforms फक्त cohorts मध्ये data देतात
एकूण दर जुने आणि नवीन ग्राहक मिसळतो, आणि अलीकडचे ग्राहक चांगले टिकताहेत की वाईट हे लपवतो
Cohorts मुळे CAC track करण्याची गरज संपते

exp.en: Grouping customers by first-order month shows if, say, festive-sale buyers repeat less than organic buyers, or if a product change improved retention. A blended rate can look stable while newer cohorts quietly get worse.
exp.hi: Customers ko first-order month se group karne se dikhta hai ki, jaise, festive-sale buyers organic buyers se kam repeat karte hain, ya product change se retention sudhra. Blended rate stable dikh sakta hai jabki naye cohorts chupchaap bigad rahe hon.
exp.mr: ग्राहकांना पहिल्या order च्या महिन्यानुसार गटबद्ध केल्यास दिसते की, उदा. festive-sale buyers organic buyers पेक्षा कमी repeat करतात, किंवा product बदलामुळे retention सुधारले. Blended दर स्थिर दिसू शकतो तर नवीन cohorts शांतपणे खराब होत असतात.

q.en: You replaced the Diwali sale banner on your site with a new one using the same file name, banner.jpg. Many users still see the old banner. Most likely cause and fix?
q.hi: Aapne site ka Diwali sale banner same file name banner.jpg ke saath naye se replace kiya. Kai users ko abhi bhi purana banner dikh raha hai. Sabse likely cause aur fix?
q.mr: तुम्ही साइटवरील Diwali sale banner त्याच file name banner.jpg ने नवीनने बदलला. अनेक users ना अजूनही जुना banner दिसतोय. बहुधा कारण आणि उपाय?

en: The domain expired — renew it
Google hasn't re-indexed the image — request indexing
The SSL certificate is caching the image — reinstall it
CDN/browser caching — purge the CDN cache and use a new versioned file name
hi: Domain expire ho gaya — renew karo
Google ne image re-index nahi ki — indexing request karo
SSL certificate image cache kar raha hai — reinstall karo
CDN/browser caching — CDN cache purge karo aur naya versioned file name use karo
mr: Domain expire झाले — renew करा
Google ने image re-index केली नाही — indexing request करा
SSL certificate image cache करत आहे — reinstall करा
CDN/browser caching — CDN cache purge करा आणि नवीन versioned file name वापरा

exp.en: CDNs and browsers keep cached copies of static files for their cache lifetime. Purging the CDN helps, but a new file name (banner-v2.jpg or ?v=2) guarantees everyone fetches the new image. SSL doesn't cache files.
exp.hi: CDNs aur browsers static files ki cached copy cache lifetime tak rakhte hain. CDN purge madad karta hai, par naya file name (banner-v2.jpg ya ?v=2) guarantee karta hai ki sab nayi image lein. SSL files cache nahi karta.
exp.mr: CDNs आणि browsers static files ची cached copy cache कालावधीपर्यंत ठेवतात. CDN purge मदत करते, पण नवीन file name (banner-v2.jpg किंवा ?v=2) सर्वांना नवीन image मिळेल याची खात्री देते. SSL files cache करत नाही.

q.en: Your store marks orders 'paid' only when the customer lands on the thank-you page. Some UPI buyers pay in their app but never return, so paid orders stay 'pending'. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapka store order ko 'paid' tabhi mark karta hai jab customer thank-you page pe aata hai. Kuch UPI buyers app mein pay karte hain par wapas nahi aate, toh paid orders 'pending' reh jaate hain. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमचे store order फक्त ग्राहक thank-you page वर आल्यावरच 'paid' mark करते. काही UPI buyers app मध्ये pay करतात पण परत येत नाहीत, त्यामुळे paid orders 'pending' राहतात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Confirm payment from the gateway's server-to-server webhook (plus a status check), not the browser redirect
Remove UPI and accept only cards
Ask customers to email a payment screenshot
Mark every order as paid automatically after one hour
hi: Payment ko gateway ke server-to-server webhook (plus status check) se confirm karo, browser redirect se nahi
UPI hata do aur sirf cards lo
Customers se payment screenshot email karwao
Ek ghante baad har order ko automatically paid mark karo
mr: Payment gateway च्या server-to-server webhook (आणि status check) ने confirm करा, browser redirect ने नाही
UPI काढून फक्त cards स्वीकारा
ग्राहकांना payment screenshot email करायला सांगा
एका तासानंतर प्रत्येक order आपोआप paid mark करा

exp.en: Browser redirects are unreliable: users close tabs, switch apps or lose network. The gateway's webhook (verified) plus a fallback status API call is the source of truth. Auto-marking orders paid would ship unpaid orders.
exp.hi: Browser redirects bharosemand nahi: users tab band karte hain, app switch karte hain, network jaata hai. Gateway ka (verified) webhook plus fallback status API call hi source of truth hai. Auto-paid mark karne se unpaid orders ship ho jayenge.
exp.mr: Browser redirects विश्वसनीय नाहीत: users tab बंद करतात, app बदलतात, network जाते. Gateway चा (verified) webhook आणि fallback status API call हाच खरा आधार आहे. आपोआप paid mark केल्यास न भरलेल्या orders ship होतील.

q.en: A D2C brand ran a flat 30% sitewide discount for a week. Orders rose 50%, but profit for the week fell. What most likely happened?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ne ek hafte flat 30% sitewide discount chalaya. Orders 50% badhe, par hafte ka profit gir gaya. Sabse likely kya hua?
q.mr: एका D2C brand ने आठवडाभर flat 30% sitewide discount चालवला. Orders 50% वाढल्या, पण आठवड्याचा नफा घटला. बहुधा काय झाले?

en: The payment gateway charged extra fees during sales
The discount ate most of the contribution margin, and many buyers would have paid full price anyway
Discounts always increase profit, so the data must be wrong
Customers bought fewer items per order
hi: Sale ke dauraan payment gateway ne extra fees li
Discount ne zyada tar contribution margin kha liya, aur kai buyers waise bhi full price pe kharidte
Discount hamesha profit badhata hai, toh data galat hoga
Customers ne har order mein kam items liye
mr: Sale दरम्यान payment gateway ने जास्त fees घेतली
Discount ने बहुतेक contribution margin खाल्ले, आणि अनेक ग्राहक तसेही पूर्ण किंमतीत घेतले असते
Discount नेहमी नफा वाढवतो, म्हणून data चुकीचा असेल
ग्राहकांनी प्रत्येक order मध्ये कमी items घेतले

exp.en: If contribution margin is 40%, a 30% discount leaves roughly a quarter of it per order — you need several times the orders just to break even. Blanket discounts also subsidise loyal buyers. Targeted offers (bundles, thresholds, first-order) protect margin better.
exp.hi: Agar contribution margin 40% hai, toh 30% discount ke baad per order uska lagbhag chauthai hi bachta hai — break-even ke liye kai guna orders chahiye. Blanket discounts loyal buyers ko bhi subsidise karte hain. Targeted offers (bundles, thresholds, first-order) margin behtar bachate hain.
exp.mr: Contribution margin 40% असल्यास 30% सुटीनंतर प्रति order त्याचा साधारण एक-चतुर्थांश उरतो — break-even साठी अनेक पट orders लागतात. Blanket discounts निष्ठावान ग्राहकांनाही सवलत देतात. Targeted offers (bundles, thresholds, first-order) margin चांगले जपतात.

q.en: You plan to move your website to a new host tomorrow. Why do experts lower the DNS record's TTL a day or two before the switch?
q.hi: Kal website naye host pe shift karni hai. Experts switch se ek-do din pehle DNS record ka TTL kam kyun karte hain?
q.mr: उद्या वेबसाइट नवीन host वर हलवायची आहे. तज्ज्ञ switch च्या एक-दोन दिवस आधी DNS record चा TTL कमी का करतात?

en: Lower TTL improves Google rankings permanently
Lower TTL makes the SSL certificate renew faster
So caches expire quickly and users reach the new server soon after the change
Lower TTL is required to transfer a domain
hi: Kam TTL se Google rankings permanently sudharti hain
Kam TTL se SSL certificate jaldi renew hota hai
Taaki caches jaldi expire hon aur change ke baad users jaldi naye server pe pahunchein
Domain transfer ke liye kam TTL zaroori hai
mr: कमी TTL मुळे Google rankings कायमस्वरूपी सुधारतात
कमी TTL मुळे SSL certificate लवकर renew होते
Caches लवकर expire होऊन बदलानंतर users लवकर नवीन server वर पोहोचावेत म्हणून
Domain transfer साठी कमी TTL आवश्यक आहे

exp.en: If TTL is 24 hours, some users may hit the old server for a day after you switch. Dropping it to ~5 minutes ahead of time (and waiting for the old TTL to pass) makes the cut-over fast; raise it again afterwards.
exp.hi: TTL 24 ghante ho toh switch ke baad kuch users ek din tak purane server pe ja sakte hain. Pehle se ~5 minute karne se (aur purana TTL guzarne dene se) cut-over fast hota hai; baad mein wapas badha do.
exp.mr: TTL 24 तास असेल तर switch नंतर काही users दिवसभर जुन्या server वर जाऊ शकतात. आधीच ~5 मिनिटे केल्यास (आणि जुना TTL संपू दिल्यास) cut-over वेगाने होतो; नंतर पुन्हा वाढवा.

q.en: A protein-snack brand: CAC ₹900, contribution ₹300 per order, and retained customers reorder every 2 months. Assuming they keep reordering, roughly what is the CAC payback?
q.hi: Ek protein-snack brand: CAC ₹900, contribution ₹300 per order, aur retained customers har 2 mahine mein reorder karte hain. Maano woh reorder karte rahein, toh CAC payback lagbhag kitna hai?
q.mr: एक protein-snack brand: CAC ₹900, contribution ₹300 प्रति order, आणि टिकलेले ग्राहक दर 2 महिन्यांनी पुन्हा order करतात. ते order करत राहिले असे मानल्यास CAC payback साधारण किती?

en: Immediately, on the first order
About 2 months
About 6 months
About 4 months (at the 3rd order)
hi: Turant, pehle order pe
Lagbhag 2 mahine
Lagbhag 6 mahine
Lagbhag 4 mahine (3rd order pe)
mr: लगेच, पहिल्या order वर
सुमारे 2 महिने
सुमारे 6 महिने
सुमारे 4 महिने (3ऱ्या order ला)

exp.en: Orders at month 0, 2 and 4 give ₹300 each; cumulative contribution reaches ₹900 at the 3rd order, month 4. In reality not everyone reorders, so use cohort retention — real payback is usually longer.
exp.hi: Month 0, 2 aur 4 pe orders, har ek ₹300; cumulative contribution 3rd order (month 4) pe ₹900 hota hai. Asli mein sab reorder nahi karte, toh cohort retention use karo — real payback aksar lamba hota hai.
exp.mr: महिना 0, 2 आणि 4 ला orders, प्रत्येकी ₹300; एकूण contribution 3ऱ्या order ला (महिना 4) ₹900 होते. प्रत्यक्षात सर्वजण पुन्हा order करत नाहीत, म्हणून cohort retention वापरा — खरा payback सहसा जास्त असतो.

q.en: Why should marketers be very careful about adding third-party JavaScript tags (chat widgets, trackers) on checkout pages?
q.hi: Marketers ko checkout pages pe third-party JavaScript tags (chat widgets, trackers) daalne mein bahut careful kyun rehna chahiye?
q.mr: Marketers नी checkout pages वर third-party JavaScript tags (chat widgets, trackers) टाकताना खूप काळजी का घ्यावी?

en: Scripts run with full page access and, if compromised, can read what users type, including payment details
Third-party scripts always block Google from indexing checkout
Browsers refuse to load scripts on HTTPS pages
Scripts on checkout automatically double the ad spend
hi: Scripts ko poore page ka access hai; compromise hone pe woh typed data, payment details samet, padh sakte hain
Third-party scripts hamesha Google ko checkout index karne se rokte hain
Browsers HTTPS pages pe scripts load nahi karte
Checkout pe scripts ad spend automatically double kar dete hain
mr: Scripts ना पूर्ण page चा access असतो आणि compromise झाल्यास ते user ने type केलेले, payment details सह, वाचू शकतात
Third-party scripts नेहमी Google ला checkout index करण्यापासून रोखतात
Browsers HTTPS pages वर scripts load करत नाहीत
Checkout वरील scripts ad spend आपोआप दुप्पट करतात

exp.en: Any script you load runs with the same power as your own code. If a vendor is hacked, card-skimming code can be injected (so-called Magecart attacks). Keep checkout scripts minimal, vetted and monitored.
exp.hi: Jo bhi script load karte ho woh aapke apne code jitni power se chalti hai. Vendor hack ho jaye toh card-skimming code inject ho sakta hai (Magecart attacks). Checkout pe scripts kam, vetted aur monitored rakho.
exp.mr: तुम्ही load केलेली प्रत्येक script तुमच्या स्वतःच्या code इतक्याच अधिकाराने चालते. Vendor hack झाल्यास card-skimming code घुसवला जाऊ शकतो (Magecart attacks). Checkout वर scripts कमी, तपासलेल्या आणि monitored ठेवा.

q.en: Which of these is a true self-reinforcing growth loop for an online design tool?
q.hi: Online design tool ke liye inmein se kaunsa sachcha self-reinforcing growth loop hai?
q.mr: Online design tool साठी यापैकी कोणता खरा self-reinforcing growth loop आहे?

en: Spending more on Google Ads each month to get more sign-ups
Users publish designs with a 'Made with' link → viewers sign up → they publish more designs
Sending a monthly newsletter to existing users
Hiring influencers for a one-time launch campaign
hi: Har mahine zyada sign-ups ke liye Google Ads pe zyada kharch karna
