Users 'Made with' link wale designs publish karte hain → viewers sign up → woh aur designs publish karte hain
Existing users ko monthly newsletter bhejna
Ek-baar ke launch campaign ke liye influencers hire karna
mr: दरमहा जास्त sign-ups साठी Google Ads वर जास्त खर्च करणे
Users 'Made with' link असलेले designs प्रकाशित करतात → viewers sign up करतात → ते आणखी designs प्रकाशित करतात
सध्याच्या users ना monthly newsletter पाठवणे
एकदाच्या launch campaign साठी influencers नेमणे

exp.en: In a loop, the output (published designs) becomes the input for new users, who create more output. Ads, newsletters and one-off influencer pushes are linear: they stop when spending stops.
exp.hi: Loop mein output (published designs) naye users ka input ban jata hai, jo aur output banate hain. Ads, newsletters aur ek-baar ke influencer push linear hain: kharch rukte hi ruk jaate hain.
exp.mr: Loop मध्ये output (प्रकाशित designs) नवीन users चा input बनतो, जे आणखी output तयार करतात. Ads, newsletters आणि एकदाचे influencer push हे linear आहेत: खर्च थांबला की थांबतात.

q.en: A D2C brand has 50% gross margin; shipping, payment fees and RTO cost another 20% of revenue. Its Meta ads report 3x ROAS. Are the ads profitable?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ka gross margin 50% hai; shipping, payment fees aur RTO revenue ka aur 20% khaate hain. Meta ads 3x ROAS report karte hain. Kya ads profitable hain?
q.mr: एका D2C brand चे gross margin 50% आहे; shipping, payment fees आणि RTO revenue चे आणखी 20% खातात. Meta ads 3x ROAS दाखवतात. Ads फायदेशीर आहेत का?

en: Yes — any ROAS above 1x is profitable
Yes — 3x ROAS means 200% profit
No — contribution before ads is 30%, so break-even ROAS is about 3.3x
Can't say without knowing the CTR
hi: Haan — 1x se upar koi bhi ROAS profitable hai
Haan — 3x ROAS matlab 200% profit
Nahi — ads se pehle contribution 30% hai, toh break-even ROAS lagbhag 3.3x hai
CTR jaane bina nahi keh sakte
mr: हो — 1x पेक्षा जास्त कोणताही ROAS फायदेशीर आहे
हो — 3x ROAS म्हणजे 200% नफा
नाही — ads आधी contribution 30% आहे, म्हणून break-even ROAS सुमारे 3.3x आहे
CTR माहीत नसताना सांगता येणार नाही

exp.en: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ contribution margin before ads = 1 ÷ 0.30 ≈ 3.33x. At 3x, every ₹100 of ad spend returns ₹300 revenue but only ₹90 contribution — a ₹10 loss (ignoring any repeat purchases).
exp.hi: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ ads se pehle ka contribution margin = 1 ÷ 0.30 ≈ 3.33x. 3x pe har ₹100 ad spend se ₹300 revenue par sirf ₹90 contribution — ₹10 loss (repeat purchases ignore karke).
exp.mr: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ ads आधीचे contribution margin = 1 ÷ 0.30 ≈ 3.33x. 3x वर प्रत्येक ₹100 ad खर्चातून ₹300 revenue पण फक्त ₹90 contribution — ₹10 तोटा (repeat purchases वगळून).

q.en: A COD-heavy fashion brand judges Meta campaigns by 'orders placed'. One campaign has the lowest cost per order but a 45% RTO rate. What should it optimise on?
q.hi: Ek COD-heavy fashion brand Meta campaigns ko 'orders placed' se judge karta hai. Ek campaign ka cost per order sabse kam hai par RTO rate 45%. Kis metric pe optimise karna chahiye?
q.mr: एक COD-heavy fashion brand Meta campaigns 'orders placed' वरून तपासतो. एका campaign चा cost per order सर्वात कमी आहे पण RTO दर 45%. कोणत्या metric वर optimise करावे?

en: Clicks, since they are the earliest signal
Orders placed, because that's what Meta reports
Impressions, to maximise reach
Cost per delivered (net of RTO) order and contribution per delivered order
hi: Clicks, kyunki woh sabse pehla signal hain
Orders placed, kyunki Meta wahi report karta hai
Impressions, reach maximise karne ke liye
Cost per delivered (RTO ke baad) order aur contribution per delivered order
mr: Clicks, कारण ते सर्वात पहिला signal आहेत
Orders placed, कारण Meta तेच दाखवते
Impressions, reach वाढवण्यासाठी
Cost per delivered (RTO वगळून) order आणि contribution per delivered order

exp.en: A 'cheap' order that comes back as RTO earns nothing and costs double shipping. Judge campaigns on delivered orders; where possible, send delivered/prepaid events back to the ad platform so it learns which buyers actually complete.
exp.hi: 'Sasta' order jo RTO ban ke wapas aaye, kuch nahi kamata aur double shipping lagti hai. Campaigns ko delivered orders pe judge karo; ho sake toh delivered/prepaid events ad platform ko wapas bhejo taaki woh seekhe kaunse buyers sach mein complete karte hain.
exp.mr: RTO होऊन परत येणारी 'स्वस्त' order काहीच कमवत नाही आणि दुहेरी shipping लागते. Campaigns delivered orders वर तपासा; शक्य असल्यास delivered/prepaid events ad platform ला परत पाठवा म्हणजे खरेच पूर्ण करणारे buyers कोण हे ते शिकेल.

q.en: What does the HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) header tell browsers?
q.hi: HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) header browsers ko kya batata hai?
q.mr: HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) header browsers ना काय सांगतो?

en: Always connect to this site over HTTPS for a set period, never plain HTTP
Block all third-party cookies on this site
Cache every page of this site for a year
Allow this site to be embedded in any iframe
hi: Ek tay period tak is site se hamesha HTTPS pe hi connect karo, plain HTTP pe kabhi nahi
Is site pe saari third-party cookies block karo
Is site ka har page ek saal tak cache karo
Is site ko kisi bhi iframe mein embed hone do
mr: ठराविक कालावधीसाठी या साइटशी नेहमी HTTPS वरच connect व्हा, साध्या HTTP वर कधीच नाही
या साइटवरील सर्व third-party cookies block करा
या साइटचे प्रत्येक page वर्षभर cache करा
ही साइट कोणत्याही iframe मध्ये embed होऊ द्या

exp.en: HSTS stops downgrade attacks where someone on public Wi-Fi forces a victim onto insecure HTTP. Once a browser sees the header, it upgrades every visit to HTTPS automatically until max-age expires. Enable it only after HTTPS works everywhere.
exp.hi: HSTS downgrade attacks rokta hai jisme public Wi-Fi pe koi victim ko insecure HTTP pe dhakel deta hai. Browser header dekh le toh max-age tak har visit automatically HTTPS pe upgrade karta hai. HTTPS har jagah chalne ke baad hi enable karo.
exp.mr: HSTS downgrade attacks थांबवतो ज्यात public Wi-Fi वर कोणी पीडिताला असुरक्षित HTTP वर ढकलतो. Browser ने header पाहिल्यावर max-age पर्यंत प्रत्येक भेट आपोआप HTTPS वर नेतो. HTTPS सगळीकडे चालू झाल्यावरच enable करा.

q.en: A food-delivery startup picks 'app downloads' as its North Star metric. Why is this a weak choice, and what's better?
q.hi: Ek food-delivery startup ne 'app downloads' ko North Star metric banaya. Yeh weak choice kyun hai, aur behtar kya hai?
q.mr: एका food-delivery startup ने 'app downloads' ला North Star metric निवडले. ही कमकुवत निवड का आहे, आणि चांगले काय?

en: It's fine — downloads are the best measure of growth
Downloads don't show value delivered; something like 'orders delivered on time per week' is better
It's weak because downloads are hard to count; use website visits
It's weak; the North Star should be the marketing budget
hi: Theek hai — downloads growth ka best measure hain
Downloads delivered value nahi dikhate; 'orders delivered on time per week' jaisa metric behtar hai
Weak hai kyunki downloads ginna mushkil hai; website visits use karo
Weak hai; North Star marketing budget hona chahiye
mr: ठीक आहे — downloads हे growth चे सर्वोत्तम माप आहे
Downloads दिलेले मूल्य दाखवत नाहीत; 'orders delivered on time per week' सारखा metric चांगला
कमकुवत कारण downloads मोजणे कठीण; website visits वापरा
कमकुवत; North Star म्हणजे marketing budget असावे

exp.en: People can download and never order, so downloads can grow while the business stalls. A value metric like on-time orders delivered captures both customer value and growth, and every team can influence it.
exp.hi: Log download karke kabhi order na karein, toh downloads badh sakte hain jabki business ruka ho. On-time orders delivered jaisa value metric customer value aur growth dono capture karta hai, aur har team use influence kar sakti hai.
exp.mr: लोक download करून कधीच order करत नाहीत, त्यामुळे व्यवसाय थांबलेला असतानाही downloads वाढू शकतात. On-time orders delivered सारखा value metric ग्राहक मूल्य आणि growth दोन्ही पकडतो, आणि प्रत्येक team त्यावर परिणाम करू शकते.

q.en: A ghee brand gets 70% of sales from Amazon/Flipkart, but after commissions, ads and returns, marketplace orders earn far less contribution than its own site. Its own site brings repeat buyers. Best strategy?
q.hi: Ek ghee brand ki 70% sales Amazon/Flipkart se aati hain, par commissions, ads aur returns ke baad marketplace orders ka contribution apni site se kaafi kam hai. Apni site se repeat buyers aate hain. Best strategy?
q.mr: एका ghee brand च्या 70% sales Amazon/Flipkart वरून येतात, पण commissions, ads आणि returns नंतर marketplace orders चे contribution स्वतःच्या साइटपेक्षा खूप कमी आहे. स्वतःच्या साइटवरून repeat buyers येतात. सर्वोत्तम strategy?

en: Leave marketplaces immediately and go 100% D2C
Put the entire budget into marketplace ads since volume is highest
Use marketplaces for discovery and volume, but grow own-site retention and compare contribution per channel
Match marketplace prices on its own site by removing all margin
hi: Turant marketplaces chhodo aur 100% D2C jao
Volume sabse zyada hai toh poora budget marketplace ads mein daalo
Marketplaces discovery/volume ke liye rakho, apni site ka retention badhao, har channel ka contribution compare karo
Saara margin hata ke apni site pe marketplace prices match karo
mr: लगेच marketplaces सोडा आणि 100% D2C व्हा
Volume सर्वात जास्त असल्याने संपूर्ण budget marketplace ads मध्ये टाका
Marketplaces discovery/volume साठी ठेवा, स्वतःच्या साइटचे retention वाढवा, प्रत्येक channel चे contribution तुलना करा
सर्व margin काढून स्वतःच्या साइटवर marketplace किंमती जुळवा

exp.en: Marketplaces bring intent-rich shoppers but own the customer data; the brand site earns more per order and enables repeats. A channel mix judged on contribution (not just revenue) beats an all-or-nothing exit that would crash volume.
exp.hi: Marketplaces intent wale shoppers laate hain par customer data unka hota hai; brand site per order zyada kamaati hai aur repeats possible banati hai. Contribution (sirf revenue nahi) pe judge kiya channel mix all-or-nothing exit se behtar hai jo volume gira dega.
exp.mr: Marketplaces खरेदीच्या उद्देशाने आलेले ग्राहक आणतात पण customer data त्यांचा असतो; brand साइट प्रति order जास्त कमावते आणि repeats शक्य करते. Contribution (फक्त revenue नाही) वर तपासलेले channel mix, volume कोसळवणाऱ्या all-or-nothing exit पेक्षा चांगले.

q.en: Your 'order paid' webhook handler sometimes creates duplicate orders in your CRM, because the gateway retries when your server responds slowly. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapka 'order paid' webhook handler kabhi-kabhi CRM mein duplicate orders bana deta hai, kyunki server slow respond kare toh gateway retry karta hai. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमचा 'order paid' webhook handler कधी कधी CRM मध्ये duplicate orders तयार करतो, कारण server हळू प्रतिसाद देतो तेव्हा gateway retry करतो. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Ask the gateway to disable retries
Delete duplicates manually every evening
Switch off the webhook and export orders weekly
Make the handler idempotent (dedupe by event/order ID) and return 2xx fast, processing in the background
hi: Gateway se retries band karwao
Har shaam manually duplicates delete karo
Webhook band karo aur har hafte orders export karo
Handler ko idempotent banao (event/order ID se dedupe) aur 2xx jaldi return karke background mein process karo
mr: Gateway ला retries बंद करायला सांगा
दररोज संध्याकाळी duplicates हाताने delete करा
Webhook बंद करून दर आठवड्याला orders export करा
Handler idempotent करा (event/order ID ने dedupe) आणि 2xx लगेच परत करून background मध्ये process करा

exp.en: Webhooks are typically delivered 'at least once', so duplicates are normal. Storing processed event IDs makes repeats harmless, and acknowledging quickly avoids timeouts that trigger retries. Disabling retries would lose real orders.
exp.hi: Webhooks aam taur pe 'at least once' deliver hote hain, toh duplicates normal hain. Processed event IDs store karne se repeats harmless ho jaate hain, aur jaldi acknowledge karne se retry trigger karne wale timeouts nahi hote. Retries band karne se asli orders kho jayenge.
exp.mr: Webhooks सहसा 'at least once' पोहोचवले जातात, म्हणून duplicates सामान्य आहेत. Processed event IDs साठवल्याने पुनरावृत्ती निरुपद्रवी होते, आणि लगेच acknowledge केल्याने retry घडवणारे timeouts टळतात. Retries बंद केल्यास खऱ्या orders हरवतील.

q.en: A brand cuts its reported CAC from ₹800 to ₹500 by offering 40% off the first order, but only counts ad spend in CAC. What's the flaw?
q.hi: Ek brand ne first order pe 40% off dekar reported CAC ₹800 se ₹500 kar diya, par CAC mein sirf ad spend ginta hai. Flaw kya hai?
q.mr: एका brand ने पहिल्या order वर 40% सूट देऊन reported CAC ₹800 वरून ₹500 केला, पण CAC मध्ये फक्त ad spend मोजतो. त्रुटी काय आहे?

en: The first-order discount is also an acquisition cost; true CAC and payback may be no better
There is no flaw — lower CAC is always better
CAC should include only organic customers
Discounts should be counted as revenue, not cost
hi: First-order discount bhi acquisition cost hai; asli CAC aur payback shayad behtar nahi hue
Koi flaw nahi — kam CAC hamesha achha hai
CAC mein sirf organic customers hone chahiye
Discounts ko revenue ginna chahiye, cost nahi
mr: पहिल्या order ची सूट हाही acquisition खर्च आहे; खरा CAC आणि payback कदाचित सुधारलेले नाहीत
कोणतीही त्रुटी नाही — कमी CAC नेहमी चांगला
CAC मध्ये फक्त organic ग्राहक असावेत
Discounts revenue म्हणून मोजावेत, खर्च म्हणून नाही

exp.en: Margin given away to win the first order is part of what it costs to acquire the customer. Deep discounts can also attract deal-seekers who don't repeat, hurting LTV. Compare fully-loaded CAC and cohort payback before and after.
exp.hi: Pehla order jeetne ke liye diya gaya margin bhi customer laane ki cost ka hissa hai. Bade discounts deal-seekers ko laate hain jo repeat nahi karte, LTV girta hai. Pehle aur baad ka fully-loaded CAC aur cohort payback compare karo.
exp.mr: पहिली order मिळवण्यासाठी सोडलेले margin हाही ग्राहक मिळवण्याच्या खर्चाचा भाग आहे. मोठ्या सवलती repeat न करणारे deal-seekers आणतात, LTV घटतो. आधी आणि नंतरचा fully-loaded CAC आणि cohort payback तुलना करा.

q.en: A D2C brand's site crashed during last year's flash sale even though images and CSS were on a CDN. The sale is next month. What's the best preparation?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ki site pichle saal flash sale mein crash ho gayi thi, jabki images aur CSS CDN pe the. Sale agle mahine hai. Best preparation kya hai?
q.mr: एका D2C brand ची साइट गेल्या वर्षी flash sale मध्ये crash झाली, जरी images आणि CSS CDN वर होते. Sale पुढच्या महिन्यात आहे. सर्वोत्तम तयारी कोणती?

en: Put the checkout page itself on the CDN cache for everyone
Load-test the origin, cache non-personalised pages, scale cart/checkout capacity and consider a queue/waiting room
Remove all product images to reduce load
Send the sale link to everyone at the exact same second
hi: Checkout page ko hi sabke liye CDN cache pe daal do
Origin load-test karo, non-personalised pages cache karo, cart/checkout scale karo, queue/waiting room socho
Load kam karne ke liye saari product images hata do
Sale link sabko ek hi second pe bhejo
mr: Checkout page च सर्वांसाठी CDN cache वर ठेवा
Origin load-test करा, non-personalised pages cache करा, cart/checkout क्षमता वाढवा, queue/waiting room विचारात घ्या
Load कमी करण्यासाठी सर्व product images काढा
Sale link सर्वांना एकाच सेकंदाला पाठवा

exp.en: CDNs offload static files, but carts, inventory and payments hit your origin and database. Load testing reveals the bottleneck; caching browse pages and queueing traffic protect checkout. Caching personalised checkout pages could show one user's cart to another.
exp.hi: CDN static files ka load leta hai, par cart, inventory aur payments origin aur database pe jaate hain. Load testing bottleneck dikhata hai; browse pages cache karna aur traffic queue karna checkout ko bachata hai. Personalised checkout cache karne se ek user ka cart doosre ko dikh sakta hai.
exp.mr: CDN static files चा भार घेते, पण cart, inventory आणि payments origin आणि database वर जातात. Load testing bottleneck दाखवते; browse pages cache करणे आणि traffic queue करणे checkout वाचवते. Personalised checkout cache केल्यास एकाचा cart दुसऱ्याला दिसू शकतो.

q.en: A SaaS for Indian CA firms has 10,000 free-plan signups but under 1% upgrade. Most users create one client file and never return. What should the growth team focus on first?
q.hi: Indian CA firms ke liye ek SaaS ke 10,000 free-plan signups hain par 1% se kam upgrade karte hain. Zyada tar users ek client file banake wapas nahi aate. Growth team ko pehle kis pe focus karna chahiye?
q.mr: भारतीय CA firms साठीच्या एका SaaS चे 10,000 free-plan signups आहेत पण 1% पेक्षा कमी upgrade करतात. बहुतेक users एक client file बनवून परत येत नाहीत. Growth team ने आधी कशावर लक्ष द्यावे?

en: Double ad spend to get 20,000 more signups
Remove the free plan entirely
Find the 'aha' action that retained users do, guide new users to it, and tie upgrade prompts to real usage limits
Cut the paid plan's price by 80%
hi: 20,000 aur signups ke liye ad spend double karo
Free plan poori tarah hata do
Retained users ka aha action dhoondo, naye users ko wahan tak le jao, upgrade prompts asli usage limits se jodo
Paid plan ki price 80% kam karo
mr: आणखी 20,000 signups साठी ad spend दुप्पट करा
Free plan पूर्णपणे काढा
टिकलेले users करतात ती 'aha' कृती शोधा, नवीन users ना तिथे न्या, आणि upgrade prompts खऱ्या usage limits शी जोडा
Paid plan ची किंमत 80% कमी करा

exp.en: The leak is activation, not acquisition or price: users don't reach value. Fix onboarding toward the behaviour that predicts retention (e.g. adding several clients), then upgrades follow naturally. More signups into a leaky bucket waste money.
exp.hi: Leak activation mein hai, acquisition ya price mein nahi: users value tak pahunchte hi nahi. Onboarding ko us behaviour ki taraf le jao jo retention predict karta hai (jaise kai clients add karna), phir upgrades naturally aate hain. Leaky bucket mein aur signups paisa barbaad hai.
exp.mr: गळती activation मध्ये आहे, acquisition किंवा किंमतीत नाही: users मूल्यापर्यंत पोहोचतच नाहीत. Retention सूचित करणाऱ्या वर्तनाकडे (उदा. अनेक clients जोडणे) onboarding न्या, मग upgrades आपोआप येतात. गळक्या बादलीत आणखी signups म्हणजे पैसे वाया.

q.en: A clinic moved its website to a new host and switched the domain's nameservers. The site works, but company email (on Google Workspace) stopped receiving mail. Most likely cause?
q.hi: Ek clinic ne website naye host pe shift ki aur domain ke nameservers badle. Site chal rahi hai, par company email (Google Workspace pe) mein mail aana band ho gaya. Sabse likely cause?
q.mr: एका clinic ने वेबसाइट नवीन host वर हलवली आणि domain चे nameservers बदलले. साइट चालते, पण company email (Google Workspace वर) मध्ये mail येणे बंद झाले. बहुधा कारण?

en: Google Workspace blocks websites on new hosts
The SSL certificate on the new host blocks email
Changing hosts always deletes old emails
The MX (and related TXT) records weren't recreated in the new DNS zone
hi: Google Workspace naye hosts wali websites ko block karta hai
Naye host ka SSL certificate email block karta hai
Host badalne se purane emails hamesha delete ho jaate hain
MX (aur related TXT) records naye DNS zone mein dobara nahi banaye gaye
mr: Google Workspace नवीन hosts वरील websites block करते
नवीन host चे SSL certificate email block करते
Host बदलल्याने जुने emails नेहमी delete होतात
MX (आणि संबंधित TXT) records नवीन DNS zone मध्ये पुन्हा तयार केले नाहीत

exp.en: Switching nameservers moves the whole DNS zone. If only the website's A/CNAME records were added, mail has no MX route. Copy every record (MX, SPF/DKIM TXT, verification) before switching nameservers.
exp.hi: Nameservers badalne se poora DNS zone shift hota hai. Agar sirf website ke A/CNAME records daale, toh mail ka MX route hi nahi. Nameservers badalne se pehle har record (MX, SPF/DKIM TXT, verification) copy karo.
exp.mr: Nameservers बदलल्याने संपूर्ण DNS zone हलतो. फक्त वेबसाइटचे A/CNAME records टाकले तर mail ला MX मार्गच नाही. Nameservers बदलण्याआधी प्रत्येक record (MX, SPF/DKIM TXT, verification) copy करा.

q.en: In the common D2C 'CM1/CM2/CM3' framework, what does CM3 usually represent?
q.hi: Common D2C 'CM1/CM2/CM3' framework mein CM3 usually kya dikhata hai?
q.mr: सामान्य D2C 'CM1/CM2/CM3' framework मध्ये CM3 सहसा काय दर्शवतो?

en: Contribution after product, fulfilment and marketing costs
Revenue after GST only
Gross margin after product cost only
Net profit after rent and salaries
hi: Product, fulfilment aur marketing costs ke baad ka contribution
Sirf GST ke baad ka revenue
Sirf product cost ke baad ka gross margin
Rent aur salaries ke baad ka net profit
mr: Product, fulfilment आणि marketing खर्चानंतरचे contribution
फक्त GST नंतरचे revenue
फक्त product खर्चानंतरचे gross margin
भाडे आणि पगारानंतरचा net profit

exp.en: Typically CM1 = revenue − product cost; CM2 = CM1 − fulfilment (shipping, packaging, payment fees, returns); CM3 = CM2 − marketing. Definitions vary slightly by company, but fixed overheads like salaries sit below CM3.
exp.hi: Aam taur pe CM1 = revenue − product cost; CM2 = CM1 − fulfilment (shipping, packaging, payment fees, returns); CM3 = CM2 − marketing. Company ke hisaab se definitions thodi badalti hain, par salaries jaise fixed overheads CM3 ke neeche aate hain.
exp.mr: सहसा CM1 = revenue − product खर्च; CM2 = CM1 − fulfilment (shipping, packaging, payment fees, returns); CM3 = CM2 − marketing. Company नुसार व्याख्या थोड्या बदलतात, पण पगारासारखे fixed overheads CM3 च्या खाली येतात.

q.en: A D2C brand's blended Meta ROAS is a healthy 4x, but most attributed purchases come from returning customers being retargeted. The CEO wants to scale spend 3x. What should you check first?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ka blended Meta ROAS healthy 4x hai, par zyada tar attributed purchases retarget kiye ja rahe returning customers se aate hain. CEO spend 3x karna chahta hai. Pehle kya check karoge?
q.mr: एका D2C brand चा blended Meta ROAS चांगला 4x आहे, पण बहुतेक attributed purchases retarget होणाऱ्या returning ग्राहकांकडून येतात. CEO ला spend 3x करायचा आहे. आधी काय तपासाल?

en: Whether CPM is below ₹100
New-customer CAC and first-order economics, ideally with an incrementality test
Whether the ad creatives use the brand colours
Only the blended ROAS trend for the last 7 days
hi: Kya CPM ₹100 se kam hai
New-customer CAC aur first-order economics, ho sake toh incrementality test ke saath
Kya ad creatives brand colours use karte hain
Sirf pichle 7 din ka blended ROAS trend
mr: CPM ₹100 पेक्षा कमी आहे का
New-customer CAC आणि first-order economics, शक्यतो incrementality test सह
Ad creatives brand रंग वापरतात का
फक्त गेल्या 7 दिवसांचा blended ROAS trend

exp.en: Retargeting existing buyers inflates ROAS — many would have bought anyway. Scaling needs new customers, whose cost is much higher. Measure spend ÷ new customers and test incrementality before tripling budget.
exp.hi: Existing buyers ko retarget karna ROAS ko inflate karta hai — kai log waise bhi kharidte. Scale ke liye naye customers chahiye, jinki cost kaafi zyada hoti hai. Budget 3x karne se pehle spend ÷ new customers measure karo aur incrementality test karo.
exp.mr: सध्याच्या buyers ना retarget केल्याने ROAS फुगतो — अनेकांनी तसेही घेतले असते. Scale साठी नवीन ग्राहक लागतात, ज्यांचा खर्च खूप जास्त असतो. Budget 3x करण्याआधी spend ÷ new customers मोजा आणि incrementality test करा.

q.en: In a referral loop, each new user sends 4 invites on average and 10% of invites convert. For every 100 users you acquire via ads, about how many total extra users will referrals add?
q.hi: Referral loop mein har naya user average 4 invites bhejta hai aur 10% invites convert hote hain. Ads se laaye har 100 users pe referrals kul milake lagbhag kitne extra users jodenge?
q.mr: Referral loop मध्ये प्रत्येक नवीन user सरासरी 4 invites पाठवतो आणि 10% invites convert होतात. Ads मधून आणलेल्या प्रत्येक 100 users मागे referrals एकूण साधारण किती अतिरिक्त users जोडतील?

en: Unlimited — the loop grows forever
About 40, and then it stops at the first round
About 67 in total across all rounds
About 400
hi: Unlimited — loop hamesha badhta rahega
Lagbhag 40, aur pehle round ke baad ruk jayega
Saare rounds milake kul lagbhag 67
Lagbhag 400
mr: अमर्याद — loop कायम वाढत राहील
सुमारे 40, आणि पहिल्या फेरीनंतर थांबेल
सर्व फेऱ्या मिळून एकूण सुमारे 67

exp.en: Viral coefficient K = 4 × 10% = 0.4. Each round brings 40%: 40 + 16 + 6.4 + … ≈ 67 extra (total = 100 ÷ (1 − 0.4)). K below 1 won't grow on its own but amplifies paid acquisition by ~1.67x.
exp.hi: Viral coefficient K = 4 × 10% = 0.4. Har round 40% laata hai: 40 + 16 + 6.4 + … ≈ 67 extra (total = 100 ÷ (1 − 0.4)). K 1 se kam ho toh khud nahi badhta, par paid acquisition ko ~1.67x amplify karta hai.
exp.mr: Viral coefficient K = 4 × 10% = 0.4. प्रत्येक फेरी 40% आणते: 40 + 16 + 6.4 + … ≈ 67 अतिरिक्त (एकूण = 100 ÷ (1 − 0.4)). K 1 पेक्षा कमी असल्यास स्वतः वाढत नाही, पण paid acquisition ~1.67x वाढवतो.

q.en: Your lead form redirects to /thank-you?email=user@gmail.com&phone=98xxxxxx. Meta and Google tags fire on that page. What's the problem and fix?
q.hi: Aapka lead form /thank-you?email=user@gmail.com&phone=98xxxxxx pe redirect karta hai. Us page pe Meta aur Google tags fire hote hain. Problem kya hai aur fix?
q.mr: तुमचा lead form /thank-you?email=user@gmail.com&phone=98xxxxxx वर redirect करतो. त्या page वर Meta आणि Google tags fire होतात. समस्या काय आणि उपाय?

en: No problem — ad platforms need the email for matching
The URL is too long for Google to index — shorten it
Tags don't fire on thank-you pages — move them to the homepage
Personal data in the URL leaks to third-party tags and logs; remove it and pass data only via approved, hashed methods
hi: Koi problem nahi — ad platforms ko matching ke liye email chahiye
URL Google index ke liye bahut lamba hai — chhota karo
Thank-you pages pe tags fire nahi hote — homepage pe daalo
URL ka personal data third-party tags aur logs tak leak hota hai; hatao, data sirf approved hashed methods se bhejo
mr: समस्या नाही — ad platforms ना matching साठी email लागतो
URL Google index साठी खूप मोठी आहे — लहान करा
Thank-you pages वर tags fire होत नाहीत — homepage वर हलवा
URL मधील personal data third-party tags आणि logs पर्यंत leak होतो; तो काढा आणि data फक्त मान्य, hashed पद्धतींनी पाठवा

exp.en: URLs are captured by analytics, ad pixels, server logs and referrers, so PII in query strings leaks to third parties and breaks platform policies and privacy laws. Use enhanced conversions/CAPI with hashed data and user consent instead.
exp.hi: URLs analytics, ad pixels, server logs aur referrers mein capture hote hain, toh query string mein PII third parties tak leak hota hai aur platform policies aur privacy laws todta hai. Iski jagah hashed data aur user consent ke saath enhanced conversions/CAPI use karo.
exp.mr: URLs analytics, ad pixels, server logs आणि referrers मध्ये नोंदल्या जातात, त्यामुळे query string मधील PII third parties पर्यंत जातो आणि platform policies व privacy कायदे मोडतो. त्याऐवजी hashed data आणि user consent सह enhanced conversions/CAPI वापरा.

q.en: A brand raised its free-shipping threshold from ₹499 to ₹999. AOV jumped 35%, but conversion rate fell 40%. The team celebrates AOV. What should decide if the change worked?
q.hi: Ek brand ne free-shipping threshold ₹499 se ₹999 kar diya. AOV 35% badha, par conversion rate 40% gira. Team AOV celebrate kar rahi hai. Change kaam kiya ya nahi, yeh kya decide karega?
q.mr: एका brand ने free-shipping threshold ₹499 वरून ₹999 केला. AOV 35% वाढला, पण conversion rate 40% घसरला. Team AOV साजरा करतेय. बदल यशस्वी झाला का हे काय ठरवेल?

en: Contribution per visitor (conversion × AOV × margin, net of shipping) versus before
AOV alone, since it went up
Conversion rate alone, since it went down
Number of items per order
hi: Contribution per visitor (conversion × AOV × margin, shipping ke baad) pehle ke mukable
Sirf AOV, kyunki woh badha
Sirf conversion rate, kyunki woh gira
Per order items ki ginti
mr: Contribution per visitor (conversion × AOV × margin, shipping वजा) आधीच्या तुलनेत
फक्त AOV, कारण तो वाढला
फक्त conversion rate, कारण तो घटला
प्रति order items ची संख्या

exp.en: Revenue per visitor = CR × AOV: 0.60 × 1.35 ≈ 0.81, i.e. about 19% less revenue per visitor. Saved shipping might offset part of that, so compare contribution per visitor — single metrics mislead in opposite directions.
exp.hi: Revenue per visitor = CR × AOV: 0.60 × 1.35 ≈ 0.81, yaani per visitor lagbhag 19% kam revenue. Bachi shipping iska kuch hissa cover kar sakti hai, toh contribution per visitor compare karo — single metrics ulti dishaon mein gumraah karte hain.
exp.mr: Revenue per visitor = CR × AOV: 0.60 × 1.35 ≈ 0.81, म्हणजे प्रति visitor सुमारे 19% कमी revenue. वाचलेले shipping याचा काही भाग भरून काढू शकते, म्हणून contribution per visitor तुलना करा — एकेकटे metrics उलट दिशांना दिशाभूल करतात.

q.en: An agency's 6-person team shares one Meta login and one Google Ads password over WhatsApp. An employee just left on bad terms. What's the best fix?
q.hi: Ek agency ki 6 logon ki team ek Meta login aur ek Google Ads password WhatsApp pe share karti hai. Ek employee abhi bure terms pe chhod ke gaya. Best fix?
q.mr: एका agency ची 6 जणांची team एक Meta login आणि एक Google Ads password WhatsApp वर शेअर करते. एक कर्मचारी नुकताच वाईट अटींवर सोडून गेला. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Change the password and share the new one on WhatsApp again
Give everyone their own login with role-based access, enforce 2FA, and remove leavers immediately
Create a second shared account as a backup
Keep the password but ask the ex-employee not to log in
hi: Password badlo aur naya wala phir WhatsApp pe share karo
Har insaan ko role-based access wala apna login do, 2FA enforce karo, aur chhodne walon ko turant hatao
Backup ke liye doosra shared account banao
Password wahi rakho par ex-employee ko login na karne bolo
mr: Password बदला आणि नवीन पुन्हा WhatsApp वर शेअर करा
प्रत्येकाला role-based access सह स्वतःचा login द्या, 2FA सक्तीचे करा, आणि सोडणाऱ्यांना लगेच काढा
Backup साठी दुसरे shared account तयार करा
Password तसाच ठेवा पण माजी कर्मचाऱ्याला login करू नको सांगा

exp.en: Shared credentials can't be revoked per person, leave no audit trail and violate platform terms. Individual access with roles lets you remove one person in seconds, and 2FA stops leaked passwords being used. Resharing on chat repeats the risk.
exp.hi: Shared credentials ko per person revoke nahi kar sakte, audit trail nahi hota, aur platform terms todte hain. Roles ke saath individual access se ek insaan ko seconds mein hata sakte ho, aur 2FA leak hue passwords ko bekaar kar deta hai. Chat pe dobara share karna wahi risk dohrata hai.
exp.mr: Shared credentials व्यक्तीनुसार रद्द करता येत नाहीत, audit trail राहत नाही, आणि platform अटी मोडतात. Roles सह वैयक्तिक access मुळे एका व्यक्तीला काही सेकंदात काढता येते, आणि 2FA leak झालेले passwords निरुपयोगी करते. Chat वर पुन्हा शेअर करणे तोच धोका पुन्हा आणते.

q.en: A profitable D2C brand has a 3-month CAC payback and must pay suppliers 60 days before goods sell. For Diwali, it wants to triple ad spend in one month. What's the biggest risk?
q.hi: Ek profitable D2C brand ka CAC payback 3 mahine hai aur use suppliers ko goods bikne se 60 din pehle pay karna padta hai. Diwali ke liye ek mahine mein ad spend 3x karna hai. Sabse bada risk kya hai?
q.mr: एका फायदेशीर D2C brand चा CAC payback 3 महिने आहे आणि त्याला माल विकला जाण्याच्या 60 दिवस आधी suppliers ना पैसे द्यावे लागतात. Diwali साठी एका महिन्यात ad spend 3x करायचा आहे. सर्वात मोठा धोका कोणता?

en: Ad platforms will reject the higher budget
ROAS will certainly double at higher spend
A cash crunch: ad spend and inventory are paid long before contribution comes back
The brand will gain too many repeat customers
hi: Ad platforms zyada budget reject kar denge
Zyada spend pe ROAS pakka double hoga
Cash crunch: ad spend aur inventory ka paisa contribution wapas aane se kaafi pehle jaata hai
Brand ke bahut zyada repeat customers ho jayenge
mr: Ad platforms जास्त budget नाकारतील
जास्त spend वर ROAS नक्की दुप्पट होईल
Cash crunch: ad spend आणि inventory चे पैसे contribution परत येण्याच्या खूप आधी जातात
Brand ला खूप जास्त repeat ग्राहक मिळतील

exp.en: Profitable-on-paper growth can still run out of cash: you prepay inventory, pay for ads now, and recover CAC over months. Scaling also tends to raise marginal CAC. Model monthly cash flow (and credit lines) before tripling spend.
exp.hi: Kagaz pe profitable growth ka bhi cash khatam ho sakta hai: inventory advance mein, ads ka paisa abhi, aur CAC mahino mein wapas. Scale karne se marginal CAC bhi badhta hai. Spend 3x karne se pehle monthly cash flow (aur credit lines) model karo.
exp.mr: कागदावर फायदेशीर growth चेही cash संपू शकते: inventory आधी, ads चे पैसे आता, आणि CAC महिन्यांनंतर परत. Scale केल्याने marginal CAC ही वाढतो. Spend 3x करण्याआधी मासिक cash flow (आणि credit lines) model करा.

q.en: A growing D2C brand on a Shopify theme has a slow mobile site. Its 2-person team (no developers) is pitched a custom 'headless' rebuild. What's the smartest first move?
q.hi: Shopify theme pe chalne wale ek growing D2C brand ki mobile site slow hai. Uski 2 logon ki team (koi developer nahi) ko custom 'headless' rebuild pitch kiya gaya hai. Sabse smart first move?
q.mr: Shopify theme वर चालणाऱ्या एका वाढत्या D2C brand ची mobile साइट मंद आहे. त्याच्या 2 जणांच्या team ला (एकही developer नाही) custom 'headless' rebuild pitch केले आहे. सर्वात हुशार पहिले पाऊल?

en: Go headless immediately — it's always faster
Move to a different platform every year
Add a speed-booster app on top of all existing apps
Audit and remove unused apps/scripts, optimise images and theme first; consider headless only if limits remain
hi: Turant headless jao — woh hamesha fast hota hai
Har saal doosra platform le lo
Saare existing apps ke upar ek speed-booster app daal do
Pehle unused apps/scripts audit karke hatao, images aur theme optimise karo; limits bani rahein tabhi headless socho
mr: लगेच headless व्हा — ते नेहमी वेगवान असते
दरवर्षी दुसरा platform घ्या
सर्व existing apps वर आणखी एक speed-booster app टाका
आधी न वापरलेले apps/scripts audit करून काढा, images आणि theme optimise करा; मर्यादा राहिल्यासच headless विचार करा

exp.en: Most slow Shopify stores are slowed by app scripts, heavy images and theme bloat, which a small team can fix cheaply. Headless can be fast but adds ongoing developer cost and complexity. Another app usually adds more script weight.
exp.hi: Zyada tar slow Shopify stores app scripts, bhaari images aur theme bloat ki wajah se slow hote hain, jo chhoti team sasta fix kar sakti hai. Headless fast ho sakta hai par ongoing developer cost aur complexity badhata hai. Ek aur app aksar aur script weight jodta hai.
exp.mr: बहुतेक मंद Shopify stores app scripts, जड images आणि theme bloat मुळे मंद असतात, जे छोटी team स्वस्तात दुरुस्त करू शकते. Headless वेगवान असू शकते पण सततचा developer खर्च आणि गुंतागुंत वाढवते. आणखी एक app सहसा script चे वजन वाढवते.
